DAWN: Diffusion-based Alignment and unfastening Workflow Network Manipulation

diffusion policy robotic manipulation unfastening multi-modal force control

简要说明：DAWN是一种分层机器人框架，利用扩散策略实现自主螺丝拆卸，通过多模态感知进行对准、阶段转换检测和力控移除，并在Franka Emika机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: DAWN is a hierarchical robotic framework using diffusion-based policies for autonomous screw unfastening, with multi-modal sensing for alignment, stage transition detection, and force-controlled removal, validated on a Franka Emika robot.

Abstract: We present DAWN (Diffusion-based Alignment and unfastening Workflow Network), a hierarchical robotic framework designed to perform real-world, unfastening tasks through multi-modal sensory integration. Autonomous robotic unfastening is crucial for improving recycling processes, enhancing safety, and reducing operational costs; yet, it remains predominantly manual due to inherent challenges in precise screwdriver engagement with fasteners, detailed force execution, and robustness to environmental variability. To address the complexity of learning long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation tasks, we subdivide the unfastening task procedure into two sequential stages: (1) alignment & insertion, and (2) unfastening. DAWN consists of three key components: AlignNet, a diffusion-based policy ensuring precise screwdriver tip engagement; LatchNet, a multi-modal classifier reliably detecting successful stage transitions; and UnfastNet, which achieves stable, force-controlled screw removal. Experimental validation on a Franka Emika robot demonstrates that DAWN achieves alignment & insertion success rates comparable to trained human operators, robustly transitions between stages, and attains an impressive success rate in unfastening across various unseen scenarios. Ablation studies further elucidate critical input modalities and effective training strategies, highlighting DAWN's scalability, robustness, and data efficiency.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了DAWN（基于扩散的对齐与旋松工作流网络），这是一个分层机器人框架，旨在通过多模态感知集成执行真实世界中的旋松任务。自主机器人旋松对于改善回收流程、提升安全性以及降低运营成本至关重要；然而，由于螺丝刀与紧固件的精确接合、精细的力执行以及对环境变化的鲁棒性等方面存在固有挑战，该任务目前仍主要依赖人工完成。为应对学习长时程、接触密集型操作任务的复杂性，我们将旋松任务流程细分为两个连续阶段：（1）对齐与插入，以及（2）旋松。DAWN由三个关键组件构成：AlignNet，一种基于扩散的策略，确保螺丝刀刀头的精确接合；LatchNet，一种多模态分类器，可靠检测阶段转换是否成功；以及UnfastNet，实现稳定的力控螺丝移除。在Franka Emika机器人上的实验验证表明，DAWN在对齐与插入方面达到了与受过训练的人类操作员相当的成功率，能够在阶段之间稳健转换，并在各种未见场景中实现令人印象深刻的旋松成功率。消融研究进一步阐明了关键输入模态和有效训练策略，凸显了DAWN的可扩展性、鲁棒性和数据效率。

Authors: Hemant Kumar, Piyush Goenka, Nikhil Chopra

HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model VLA

Vision-Language-Action World Model Hierarchical Foresight Action-Guided Retrieval Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：HiFOR 提出了一种分层预见框架，结合动作引导的世界检索，用于视觉-语言-动作模型。它通过分层依赖掩码联合预测短期状态演化、语义里程碑和最终目标状态，并基于动作表示从结构化潜在世界中检索相关未来信息以指导动作生成，在仿真基准和六个真实机器人操作任务上验证了有效性。

TLDR: HiFOR proposes a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval for VLA models, jointly predicting short-term dynamics, semantic milestones, and goal states, and retrieving relevant future latents to guide action generation, validated on simulation benchmarks and six real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过整合视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，在机器人操作任务中展现出了良好的能力。近年来的研究进一步引入未来预测机制，以增强对环境动态和任务进展的理解。然而，现有方法通常将短期动态建模与长期任务目标分开处理，同时直接将预测得到的未来信息融入动作策略，而未充分考量其与当前动作需求之间的相关性。为克服上述局限，我们提出HiFOR——一种基于动作引导的世界检索的分层前瞻框架。具体而言，分层前瞻预测模块通过分层依赖掩码（HDM）联合预测短期状态演化、语义里程碑和最终目标状态，从而在不同时间尺度之间建立依赖关系。在此基础上，结构感知的潜在世界建模模块沿时间轴、视角和空间维度组织未来潜在表征，以支持细粒度的检索。进一步地，动作引导的因子化世界检索模块在去噪过程中根据动态演化的动作表征，从结构化的潜在世界中自适应地检索相关未来信息，从而为动作生成提供有针对性的引导。在两个仿真基准测试及六项真实世界机器人操作任务上的大量实验验证了该方法的高效性。

Authors: Rongxing Ding, Hongyu Qu, Kehong Wu, Xudong Wang, Fan Zhang, Xinguang Xiang, Xiangbo Shu

LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots Locomotion

loco-manipulation quadruped robots LLM-guided planning whole-body pushing reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种由LLM引导的四足机器人移动操作分层框架，通过LoRA微调的任务规划器联合选择技能、物体和几何目标，并结合端到端全身平面推动策略，在仿真和硬件上均取得了较高的成功率。

TLDR: The paper presents an LLM-guided hierarchical framework for quadruped loco-manipulation that jointly selects skills, objects, and geometric targets via a LoRA-fine-tuned planner and an end-to-end whole-body planar pushing policy, achieving strong simulation and hardware success rates.

Abstract: Robotic navigation typically assumes a collision-free route to the goal exists; in cluttered environments with movable obstacles, however, reaching the goal may require physical interaction. Classical solutions encode these behaviors through geometric rules and task-specific logic, while learning-based approaches often constrain the decision space to low-dimensional motion commands or predefined action sets. We instead consider a broader decision space, jointly selecting the skill, relevant object, and geometric target. Our language-conditioned task planner, fine-tuned with LoRA on synthetic data, maps natural-language tasks and a structured scene representation to variable-length sequences of parameterized actions, executed by low-level reinforcement-learning policies. The planner learns the geometric relations underlying interactive navigation and outperforms a classical planner and a prompted frontier model on interactive navigation tasks. Comparisons with models trained from scratch indicate that composition does not require pretraining when the representation is structured, whereas pretraining yields more reliable geometric targets. At the low level, we introduce an end-to-end whole-body planar pushing policy that achieves a 93.3% success rate in simulation, versus 83.5% for a hierarchical baseline, while reducing completion time by more than 60%. On hardware, the hierarchy yields the correct skill composition in 44/45 trials and end-to-end success in 34/45. Project website: https://anonymousprojects-dev.github.io/LLM-guided-LocoManipulation-Quadrupeds/

摘要（中文）：机器人导航通常假设存在一条通往目标的无碰撞路径；然而，在存在可移动障碍物的杂乱环境中，到达目标可能需要物理交互。经典解决方案通过几何规则和任务特定逻辑来编码这些行为，而基于学习的方法通常将决策空间限制为低维运动指令或预定义动作集。我们转而考虑更广泛的决策空间，联合选择技能、相关物体和几何目标。我们的语言条件任务规划器在合成数据上通过LoRA进行微调，将自然语言任务和结构化场景表示映射为可变长度的参数化动作序列，并由底层强化学习策略执行。该规划器学习了交互式导航背后的几何关系，并在交互式导航任务上优于经典规划器和提示驱动的前沿模型。与从头训练的模型相比，结果表明当表示具有结构化特征时，组合并不需要预训练，而预训练能产生更可靠的几何目标。在底层，我们引入了一种端到端的全身平面推挤策略，在仿真中实现了93.3%的成功率，而分层基线为83.5%，同时完成时间减少了60%以上。在硬件上，该层级结构在44/45次试验中产生了正确的技能组合，并在34/45次试验中实现了端到端成功。项目网站：https://anonymousprojects-dev.github.io/LLM-guided-LocoManipulation-Quadrupeds/

Authors: Georges Jetti, Michael Khayyat, Jean-Pierre Sleiman, Stefano Arrigoni, Francesco Braghin

AcrossDEX 1.0: From Human Motion Pretraining to Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation across Hand Embodiments Manipulation

bimanual dexterous manipulation human motion pretraining cross-embodiment visual closed-loop execution generative policy

简要说明：AcrossDEX 1.0提出了一种将人类运动预训练迁移到双臂灵巧操作的学习系统，支持两种不同的手部硬件，并在真实机器人任务中实现了高成功率。

TLDR: AcrossDEX 1.0 presents a learning system that transfers human motion pretraining to bimanual dexterous manipulation across two different hand embodiments, achieving high success rates on real robot tasks via direct regression and generative policies.

Abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of wrist motion, finger contact, and object motion. Human videos provide rich manipulation experience. Using this experience for robot control requires aligning human poses with robot commands and accounting for embodiment-specific kinematics and contact dynamics. We present AcrossDEX 1.0, a learning system that connects human motion pretraining, simulation-based expert learning, robot demonstration collection, and visual closed-loop execution. Pretraining on HOT3D Aria predicts one second of bimanual motion from five images and thirty annotated hand states over the preceding second. Robot adaptation preserves the visual encoder, temporal backbone, and wrist parameters. Shared wrist representations, separate finger fields, and validity masks support both six-channel Inspire hands and sixteen-joint Allegro hands. The robot policy predicts sixty control targets from frontal images, command history, and task conditions. It executes a prefix and replans from updated observations. We compare direct regression, diffusion, and flow matching on lid opening and return and closed-lid object reorientation. Direct regression achieves success rates of 40.6\% for opening and return, 100.0\% for Inspire reorientation, and 93.3\% for Allegro reorientation. Flow matching achieves 90.0\% on Allegro reorientation. Paired comparisons further show that constraining replanning with the previous plan improves the continuous execution of generative policies. These results demonstrate a common adaptation pipeline for two hand embodiments and highlight the roles of contact coordination and action-chunk continuity.

摘要（中文）：双手灵巧操作需要手腕运动、手指接触和物体运动的持续协调。人类视频提供了丰富的操作经验。将这些经验用于机器人控制，需要将人体姿态与机器人命令对齐，并考虑具体 embodiment 的运动学和接触动力学。我们提出了 AcrossDEX 1.0，一个连接人类运动预训练、基于仿真的专家学习、机器人演示采集和视觉闭环执行的学习系统。在 HOT3D Aria 上的预训练根据前一刻的五张图像和三十个标注手部状态预测一秒的双手运动。机器人适配保留视觉编码器、时间骨干网络和手腕参数。共享手腕表示、独立手指场和有效性掩码支持六通道 Inspire 手和十六关节 Allegro 手。机器人策略根据正面图像、命令历史和任务条件预测六十个控制目标。它执行一个前缀，并根据更新后的观测重新规划。我们在开盖并放回以及闭合盖子的物体重定向任务上比较了直接回归、扩散和流匹配。直接回归在开盖并放回上达到 40.6\% 的成功率，在 Inspire 重定向上达到 100.0\%，在 Allegro 重定向上达到 93.3\%。流匹配在 Allegro 重定向上达到 90.0\%。成对比较进一步表明，用先前计划约束重新规划可以改善生成式策略的连续执行。这些结果展示了两种手部 embodiment 的通用适配流程，并突出了接触协调和动作块连续性的作用。

Authors: Xiaoyu Yang, Nan Wu

PRIME W0: Physical Priors from World Models for Embodied Manipulation VLA

hierarchical flow-matching world-model subgoal prediction KV injection Action Dynamic Manifold adaptive MoE

简要说明：PRIME W0提出了一种用于VLA模型的分层条件流匹配框架，结合世界模型子目标预测和动力学感知条件化，在LIBERO和真实机器人基准上取得了最先进的操作结果。

TLDR: PRIME W0 introduces a hierarchical conditional flow-matching framework for VLA models, integrating world-model subgoal prediction and dynamics-aware conditioning to achieve state-of-the-art manipulation results on LIBERO and real-robot benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at instruction following, yet most remain feed-forward: they condition actions only on the current observation and discard both long-horizon temporal context and the hierarchical structure of VLM representations. We present PRIME W0, a hierarchical conditional flow-matching framework that closes this gap through three synergistic designs: (1)per-layer KV injection from a pretrained VLM into an Adaptive MoE action expert; (2)dynamics-aware conditioning via asynchronous world-model subgoal-image prediction and a DINOv2 historical-frame semantic bridge; and (3)Action Dynamic Manifold (ADM) flow matching with covariance-structured noise that respects robot kinematic coupling. PRIME W0 is trained in four stages---VLM pre-training, DAT/NTP visuomotor pre-training, DiT flow-matching decoder assembly with WM injection, and end-to-end SFT---and achieves state-of-the-art results on LIBERO and real-robot benchmarks, with systematic ablations validating each architectural component.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在指令跟随方面表现出色，但大多数仍为前馈式：它们仅以当前观测为条件生成动作，丢弃了长时程时间上下文和VLM表示中的层次化结构。我们提出PRIME W0，一种层次化条件流匹配框架，通过三项协同设计弥合这一差距：（1）将预训练VLM的逐层KV注入自适应MoE动作专家；（2）通过异步世界模型子目标图像预测和DINOv2历史帧语义桥接实现动力学感知条件化；（3）动作动态流形（ADM）流匹配，采用尊重机器人运动学耦合的协方差结构化噪声。PRIME W0分四个阶段训练——VLM预训练、DAT/NTP视觉运动预训练、带WM注入的DiT流匹配解码器组装以及端到端SFT——在LIBERO和真实机器人基准上取得最先进结果，并通过系统性消融实验验证了每个架构组件。

Authors: Huabin Peng, Fagang Jin, Yancong Wei, Tengfei Ma, Chuhang Liu, Chao Yu, Liqing Chen

SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing Manipulation

tool-centric manipulation interchangeable end-effectors tactile sensing imitation learning contact-rich tasks

简要说明：SwapBot提出了一种模块化的以工具为中心的末端执行器系统，通过低成本适配器将家用工具转换为机器人末端执行器，集成触觉传感并支持模仿学习完成接触丰富的操作任务。

TLDR: SwapBot presents a modular tool-centric end-effector system with low-cost adapters that convert household tools into robot end-effectors, integrating tactile sensing and enabling imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Robot manipulation in everyday environments inherently involves substantial tool usage. Seemingly simple household tasks, such as cooking pan-fried tofu, require forceful cutting, delicate brushing, and precise placement using different tools under contact-rich interaction. Thus, the ability to autonomously swap and use task-appropriate tools is important for tool-centric manipulation. We introduce SwapBot, a modular, tool-centric end effector system featuring low-cost adapters that quickly convert common household tools into robot end effectors. Rather than pursuing a single universal gripper, SwapBot adopts a unified design principle that combines a fixed robot-side coupling interface with low-cost, tool-side adapters, enabling compatibility with diverse tools, including articulated ones, and multiple robot platforms. Each adapter integrates compact tactile sensors, supports fast autonomous swapping, and interfaces with an intuitive teleoperation system for efficient demonstration collection. User studies show that, during teleoperation, SwapBot reduces task completion time and operator workload. Using collected demonstrations on the robot, we train imitation learning policies to successfully perform tool-centric tasks like cooking tofu, stirring salad, flipping meat. Our ablation study shows that using tactile-augmented demonstrations improves policy performance across contact-rich skills, increasing success rates by 15 to 25 percentage points over RGB-only policies. These results highlight modular, tactile-equipped tools as a practical and extensible pathway toward robust and capable robot manipulation. Project website https://personalrobotics.github.io/SwapBot.

摘要（中文）：摘要：日常环境中的机器人操作本质上涉及大量工具使用。看似简单的家务任务，例如烹饪煎豆腐，需要在富接触交互下使用不同工具进行有力切割、精细刷涂和精确放置。因此，自主更换并使用适合任务的工具对于以工具为中心的操作至关重要。我们提出了SwapBot，一种模块化的、以工具为中心的末端执行器系统，其特点是低成本适配器，可将常见家用工具快速转换为机器人末端执行器。SwapBot并非追求单一通用夹爪，而是采用统一设计原则，将固定的机器人侧耦合接口与低成本工具侧适配器相结合，从而兼容多种工具（包括铰接式工具）和多种机器人平台。每个适配器集成了紧凑型触觉传感器，支持快速自主更换，并与直观的遥操作系统对接，以便高效收集示范数据。用户研究表明，在遥操作过程中，SwapBot减少了任务完成时间和操作员工作负荷。利用在机器人上收集的示范数据，我们训练模仿学习策略，成功执行以工具为中心的任务，如烹饪豆腐、搅拌沙拉、翻动肉类。我们的消融实验表明，使用触觉增强示范可提升富接触技能的策略性能，相比仅使用RGB的策略，成功率提高了15至25个百分点。这些结果凸显了模块化、配备触觉的工具作为实现鲁棒且高能力机器人操作的实用且可扩展路径。项目网站：https://personalrobotics.github.io/SwapBot。

Authors: Yunchu Zhang, Ray Song, Junhan Jiao, Liyiming Ke, Yuchen Yang, Ruihan Gao, Emma Romig, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Yiyue Luo

PhysVLMM: Interaction-Conditioned Physical Belief Maps for Articulated Objects in Robot Scene Maps Manipulation

articulated objects physical belief map mobile manipulation risk-aware planning robot scene maps

简要说明：PhysVLMM 为机器人场景地图中的铰接物体维护交互条件下的物理信念地图，使规划器能够在给定风险下查询拉动动作是否会成功，并可选择弃权。

TLDR: PhysVLMM maintains interaction-conditioned physical belief maps for articulated objects in robot scene maps, enabling planners to query whether a pull will succeed with calibrated risk and abstention.

Abstract: Mobile robots must open doors and drawers, yet their scene maps record what each object is and whether it has moved, not how it will respond to a pull. This paper proposes PhysVLMM, a method that maintains a physical belief for every articulated part of a Vision-Language-Motion Map and answers a planner's queries about it, with two algorithms: a map update and a query. Watching a part move provably cannot identify its dynamics, and a measured pull identifies only the pulled part, up to one direction. PhysVLMM therefore (i) keeps that direction as a posterior instead of a point estimate, (ii) passes the evidence of each pull in closed form to the untouched look-alike parts of the map, and (iii) answers whether an action will succeed at a stated risk, or abstains. On real doors and drawers in 18 homes, it identifies the joint type in 86% of held-out pulls (48% for a learned single-view method) and predicts the response to a pull with 41% lower error than differentiable simulation (CRPS 0.323 vs. 0.544), four orders of magnitude faster (13 ms vs. 230 s per case). The posterior lowers the final-position error from 0.460 to 0.270, sharing lowers the force error of untouched parts from 56% to 42%, and at every stated risk from 0.02 to 0.30 the false-safe answers stay within it. Pooling all measured parts of a home does as well as the look-alike groups, and simpler variants predict where a pulled part stops at least as well.

摘要（中文）：移动机器人必须会开门和抽屉，但其场景地图记录的是每个物体是什么、是否移动过，而不是它对拉拽会如何响应。本文提出PhysVLMM，一种为视觉-语言-运动地图中每个铰接部件维护物理信念并回答规划器相关查询的方法，包含两种算法：地图更新和查询。观察一个部件运动可证明无法识别其动力学特性，而一次测量拉拽只能识别被拉拽的部件，且至多确定一个方向。因此，PhysVLMM (i) 将该方向保留为后验分布而非点估计，(ii) 以闭式形式将每次拉拽的证据传递给地图中未被触碰的相似部件，(iii) 回答某个动作是否会在给定风险下成功，或弃权。在18个家庭的真实门和抽屉上，它在留出拉拽中识别关节类型的准确率为86%（学习式单视图方法为48%），预测拉拽响应的误差比可微仿真低41%（CRPS 0.323 vs. 0.544），速度快四个数量级（每案例13 ms vs. 230 s）。后验将最终位置误差从0.460降至0.270，共享将未触碰部件的力误差从56%降至42%，并且在从0.02到0.30的每个给定风险下，错误安全回答均保持在该风险之内。汇集一个家庭中所有已测量部件与相似组效果相当，而更简单的变体预测被拉拽部件停止位置的效果至少同样好。

Authors: Dibyendu Ghosh

BURGER: Benchmarking and Understanding Robotic Generalization via Embodied Drawing VLA

vision-language-action models robotic generalization simulation benchmark drawing trajectories language grounding

简要说明：BURGER 提出了一个可扩展的、由提示驱动的语言条件机器人绘图基准，提供 28,200 个模拟演示，用于评估 VLA 模型在语言接地、空间组合和多模态行为方面的表现，并在 Franka Panda 机械臂上进行了实际部署。

TLDR: BURGER introduces a scalable, prompt-driven benchmark for language-conditioned robotic drawing, providing 28,200 simulated demonstrations to evaluate VLA models on language grounding, spatial composition, and multimodal behavior, with real-world deployment on a Franka Panda arm.

Abstract: How effectively can vision-language-action (VLA) models learn diverse language-conditioned behaviors as training data scales? Investigating this question requires large and varied robot datasets, whose collection on physical robots remains costly. We introduce BURGER, a language-conditioned robotic drawing benchmark with a scalable, prompt-driven pipeline for generating continuous drawing trajectories, both in simulation and the real world. In BURGER, an agent starts from the same blank canvas and controls a robot arm to draw the object or spatial composition specified by language, while each instruction allows an open-ended variety of valid drawings and stroke orders. Using 28,200 simulated demonstrations spanning 282 drawing tasks, we evaluate five representative VLA models across data scales, language grounding, and multimodal behavior. BURGER supports fine-grained analysis of language grounding, spatial composition, and action generation, revealing distinct failure patterns across VLA models. Our experiments suggest that some VLA models can benefit from greater task diversity and demonstration scale, capture multimodal drawing behaviors, and generalize to unseen compositions of familiar objects. Finally, we deploy a trained policy on a Franka Panda arm, demonstrating the ability to draw reactively under human intervention. Project homepage and code can be found at https://siyingzhao.github.io/BURGER/.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在学习多样化语言条件化行为方面的效果，会如何随着训练数据规模的扩大而变化？探究这一问题需要大规模且多样化的机器人数据集，而在物理机器人上收集此类数据仍成本高昂。为此，我们提出了BURGER——一个语言条件化的机器人绘图基准，其采用可扩展的、由提示驱动的流程，能够在仿真环境和真实世界中生成连续的绘图轨迹。在BURGER中，智能体从相同的空白画布出发，控制机械臂绘制由语言指定的物体或空间构图，而每条指令都允许存在多种有效的绘图方式和笔画顺序。利用覆盖282项绘图任务的28,200条仿真演示，我们评估了五种具有代表性的VLA模型在数据规模、语言接地和多模态行为方面的表现。BURGER支持对语言接地、空间构图和动作生成的细粒度分析，揭示了不同VLA模型之间各异的失败模式。我们的实验表明，某些VLA模型能够从更大的任务多样性和演示规模中获益，捕捉多模态绘图行为，并泛化到熟悉物体的未见组合。最后，我们将训练好的策略部署到Franka Panda机械臂上，展示了在人工干预下进行反应式绘图的能力。项目主页和代码可在 https://siyingzhao.github.io/BURGER/ 获取。

Authors: Xiangyu Xu, Bangshuai Peng, Ziyi Liu, Mengjie Zhao, Chenhao Lu, Zhengyang Fan, Huazhe Xu, Kaizhe Hu

Improving Fine-Grained Manipulation through Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design VLA

vision-language-action policy demonstration expansion execution design fine-grained manipulation closed-loop replanning

简要说明：DEED通过跨指令和视觉条件的演示扩展以及执行设计（如逆运动学和夹爪映射），将预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略适应于细粒度操作任务，在MetaFine基准上取得了85.55%的官方分数。

TLDR: DEED adapts a pretrained VLA policy to fine-grained manipulation tasks by expanding demonstrations across instructions and visual conditions, and by designing execution strategies such as inverse kinematics and gripper mappings, achieving an 85.55% official score on MetaFine benchmarks.

Abstract: Fine-grained manipulation requires a robot policy to follow instructions, remain robust to visual variations, and translate predicted actions into precise robot control. We present Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design (DEED), a framework for adapting a pretrained vision-language-action policy to the five MetaFine tasks through structured demonstration expansion and execution design. DEED generates demonstrations for different instructions from the same initial scene and renders each physical trajectory under different camera positions and lighting conditions while preserving its original states and action targets. A hierarchical sampling strategy balances instructions, trajectories, and visual conditions during supervised adaptation. At deployment, DEED converts predicted action chunks into robot commands using inverse kinematics, gripper mappings selected for each task, and closed-loop replanning. DEED achieves an official Overall score of 85.55%. Fixed-policy evaluations show that performance varies with execution horizon, denoising budget, and gripper mapping.

摘要（中文）：细粒度操作要求机器人策略能够遵循指令、对视觉变化保持鲁棒性，并将预测动作转化为精确的机器人控制。我们提出了演示扩展与执行设计（DEED），一个通过结构化演示扩展和执行设计将预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略适配到五个MetaFine任务的框架。DEED针对同一初始场景下的不同指令生成演示，并在不同相机位置和光照条件下渲染每条物理轨迹，同时保留其原始状态和动作目标。在监督适配过程中，分层采样策略对指令、轨迹和视觉条件进行平衡。在部署阶段，DEED利用逆运动学、为每个任务选择的夹爪映射以及闭环重规划，将预测的动作块转换为机器人命令。DEED取得了85.55%的官方总评分。固定策略评估表明，性能随执行时域、去噪预算和夹爪映射而变化。

Authors: Jingxu Gu, Dongze Lian

Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds Locomotion

unsupervised environment design quadruped locomotion curriculum learning domain randomization MuJoCo MJX

简要说明：本文提出了一个综合基准，比较了用于四足机器人运动策略训练的无监督环境设计、域随机化和机器人课程方法，发现没有任何方法在所有机器人和地形分布上均占优。

TLDR: This paper presents a comprehensive benchmark comparing unsupervised environment design (UED), domain randomization, and robotics curricula methods for training quadrupedal locomotion policies in simulation, revealing that no single method dominates across robots and terrain distributions.

Abstract: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

摘要（中文）：无监督环境设计（UED）方法，如PLR、ACCEL、SFL和PAIRED，主要在二维迷宫、网格世界和BipedalWalker上进行比较，而腿式机器人的地形课程则是手工设计的，并仅针对少数基线进行评估。我们提出了一个基准测试，在MuJoCo MJX中的五个三维四足机器人上，以统一协议运行十四种UED、领域随机化和机器人课程：闭链的W01-TEK以及开链的Unitree Go1和Go2、Google Barkour vB和Boston Dynamics Spot。关卡是八个可解释地形参数的向量，所有课程在匹配的环境步预算下驱动相同的PPO学生模型。评估报告了在随机和保留的结构化地形上的成功率、四分位均值及分层自助区间、能力包络以及逐级支配比较。我们在每个机器人内部比较方法，并针对每个关卡集报告显著不低于最佳方法的顶部方法组。没有任何方法在每个机器人和关卡集上都处于顶部组。具有简单或低难度训练关卡的方法，无论是否经过策划，在Go1和Barkour以及除PAIRED+BiBC之外的W01-TEK的分布内随机关卡上都占据了顶部组。来自腿式机器人实践的成功驱动地形课程最常处于顶部组，均匀级别上的领域随机化从未进入顶部组，PAIRED在Spot之外也从未进入，而在Spot上十四种方法在难度0.25的随机关卡上差距在3.8个百分点以内。在三个机器人上，分布内随机关卡的领先者并非保留地形上的领先者。我们将结果整理为针对每个机器人的课程选择指南。

Authors: Jakub Gilewicz, Dominik Galus, Piotr Wojdas

JEDI: Joint-Embedding Demonstration Compression for In-Context Imitation Learning Manipulation

in-context imitation learning demonstration compression latent slots video-JEPA manipulation

简要说明：JEDI 通过在 video-JEPA 空间中预测下一关键帧来将演示压缩为潜在槽位，从而在 LIBERO 和真实机器人上实现多示例情境模仿学习。

TLDR: JEDI compresses demonstrations into latent slots by predicting the next keyframe in a video-JEPA space, enabling many-shot in-context imitation learning on LIBERO and real robots.

Abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) adapts robot policies through test-time demonstrations, but long multimodal trajectories constrain how many examples fit in context. We ask what a compressed demonstration should preserve. We propose JEDI, which compresses demonstrations into latent slots trained to predict the query episode's next-stage keyframe in a frozen video-JEPA space. Task and process counterfactuals help the slots preserve execution details, while the predictor selects demonstrations from a bank. Post-training with keypoint tokens enables human-hand conditioning on robots. Experiments on LIBERO and real robots show that JEDI supports many-shot context; LIBERO objective controls show improved success and demonstration following over action-only compression. These findings support query-future prediction as a training objective for preserving execution-relevant information in compressed demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：上下文模仿学习（ICIL）通过测试时的演示来调整机器人策略，但长多模态轨迹限制了上下文能够容纳的示例数量。我们提出一个问题：压缩后的演示应当保留什么？我们提出了JEDI，它将演示压缩为潜在槽位，这些槽位经过训练，能够在冻结的视频-JEPA空间中预测查询回合的下一阶段关键帧。任务和过程反事实有助于这些槽位保留执行细节，而预测器则从演示库中选择演示。使用关键点令牌进行后训练，使机器人能够以人手为条件。在LIBERO和真实机器人上的实验表明，JEDI支持多样本上下文；LIBERO客观控制实验表明，相较于仅动作压缩，其成功率和演示跟随能力均有所提升。这些发现支持将查询未来预测作为一种训练目标，用于在压缩演示中保留与执行相关的信息。

Authors: Jiazhao Liang, Zhewen He, Shuaihang Yuan, Hao Huang, Yi Fang

TouchBridge: Tactile-Conditioned Human-to-Robot Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

tactile-conditioned retargeting human-to-robot transfer vision-language-action model dexterous manipulation cross-embodiment correspondence

简要说明：TouchBridge提出了一种硬件-软件协同框架，通过跨本体的视觉和触觉对应将人类示教转换为机器人数据，无需物体网格或仿真即可高效微调VLA策略进行接触丰富的灵巧操作。

TLDR: TouchBridge presents a hardware-software framework that transfers human demonstrations to robot data using cross-embodiment visual and tactile correspondence, enabling efficient fine-tuning of VLA policies for contact-rich dexterous manipulation without object meshes or simulation.

Abstract: Human demonstrations offer an efficient and scalable source of data for dexterous robot manipulation, but differences in sensing and hand morphology complicate the transfer of contact-rich interactions. We present TouchBridge, a hardware--software co-designed framework for human-to-robot data transformation. A wearable human demonstration interface and a corresponding robot interface establish cross-embodiment correspondence in visual and fingertip tactile sensing. We introduce Tac-Retarget, a tactile-conditioned retargeting method that uses measured contact to align fingertip contact patches and preserve their spatial relations within and across hands. Unlike object-aware or simulation-based transfer pipelines, Tac-Retarget requires no object mesh, object-pose estimate, or physics simulation for retargeting, enabling direct and scalable conversion of human demonstrations into robot-domain training data. Combined with visual synthesis and camera-anchored action conversion, TouchBridge produces robot-domain demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, policies fine-tuned solely on TouchBridge-converted human demonstrations achieve a 72.5% average success rate, compared with 77.5% using an equal number of teleoperated robot demonstrations, while human demonstration collection is 7.0x faster. Under the same policy and training setup, Tac-Retarget outperforms DexPilot and UniDex by 25.0 and 42.5 percentage points, respectively.

摘要（中文）：人类演示为灵巧机器人操作提供了一种高效且可扩展的数据来源，但传感和手部形态的差异使得富含接触的交互难以迁移。我们提出了TouchBridge，一个用于人到机器人数据转换的软硬件协同设计框架。一套可穿戴人类演示接口和相应的机器人接口在视觉与指尖触觉传感方面建立了跨 embodiment 对应关系。我们引入了Tac-Retarget，一种以触觉为条件的重定向方法，利用测得的接触来对齐指尖接触区域，并保持其在手内及手间的空间关系。与基于物体感知或仿真的迁移流程不同，Tac-Retarget 在重定向时无需物体网格、物体位姿估计或物理仿真，从而能够直接且可扩展地将人类演示转换为机器人域训练数据。结合视觉合成和以相机为锚点的动作转换，TouchBridge 生成机器人域演示，用于微调预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。在四项真实世界富含接触的任务中，仅使用 TouchBridge 转换的人类演示进行微调的策略平均成功率达到 72.5%，而使用同等数量的遥操作机器人演示则为 77.5%，同时人类演示采集速度快 7.0 倍。在相同策略和训练设置下，Tac-Retarget 分别比 DexPilot 和 UniDex 高出 25.0 和 42.5 个百分点。

Authors: Haozhe Zhang, Gu Zhang, Zirui Zou, Yuzheng Chen, Jinlong Wu, Zixuan Hu, Jianke Zhang, Yucheng Hu, Zhecheng Yuan, Huazhe Xu

Gaussian Distillation of Flow Policies RLRobot

flow policies Gaussian Action Readout inference speed closed-form likelihoods robot control

简要说明：本文提出高斯动作读出（GAR），用高斯读出替换流策略的最终层，仅用极少状态训练，在保持接近教师任务成功率的同时，将推理速度提升至两倍并提供闭式似然。

TLDR: The paper proposes the Gaussian Action Readout (GAR), which replaces a flow policy's final layer with a Gaussian readout trained on a tiny fraction of states, maintaining near-teacher task success with up to twice the inference speed and closed-form likelihoods.

Abstract: Flow policies are among the strongest robot controllers and are well suited to modelling multimodal action distributions. Our analysis shows that the continuous-action distributions of the studied flow policies are well approximated by Gaussians. We propose the Gaussian Action Readout (GAR), which replaces a flow policy's final layer with a Gaussian readout trained on just 0.02% of eligible states, while keeping the rest of the network frozen. It samples with one action-network pass, gives closed-form likelihoods, and achieves near-teacher task success at up to twice the inference speed.

摘要（中文）：流策略是最强大的机器人控制器之一，非常适合建模多模态动作分布。我们的分析表明，所研究的流策略的连续动作分布可由高斯分布很好地近似。我们提出了高斯动作读出（GAR），该方法用仅在0.02%的合格状态上训练的高斯读出层替换流策略的最终层，同时保持网络其余部分冻结。它通过一次动作网络前向传播进行采样，提供闭式似然，并以最高两倍的推理速度实现接近教师模型的任务成功率。

Authors: Youssef Saied, Ziyad Sheebaelhamd, Claire Vernade, François Fleuret

Coupled Guidance for Flow Matching RLRobot

Flow Matching Guidance Diffusion Models Robotic Control Collision Avoidance

简要说明：本文提出了耦合引导，一种针对流匹配的引导机制，通过保持训练时的耦合分布，提升了机器人控制和图像生成任务的稳定性与样本质量。

TLDR: This paper proposes Coupled Guidance, a flow-matching-specific guidance mechanism that preserves the coupling distribution during training, improving stability and sample quality in robotic control and image generation tasks.

Abstract: Guidance methods are essential tools for steering the generation process in diffusion models, improving the generalizability of stochastic robotic controllers and enabling high-quality controlled image synthesis. Despite strong parallels between flow-matching and diffusion, integrating guidance into flow-matching models remains quite challenging. Recent work has proposed general guidance frameworks for flow-matching, however, they are direct adaptations of diffusion guidance methods and can prove unstable. In this work, we conduct a theoretical analysis of guidance in flow-matching and show that a naive translation of diffusion-based guidance to flow-matching breaks the coupling distribution used during training, resulting in weaker control over sampling accuracy. Building on this insight, we propose Coupled Guidance, a flow-matching-specific guidance mechanism derived from a geometric perspective that leverages the coupling structure inherent to flow-matching training. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct extensive experimentation on a custom robotic collision avoidance task using ManiSkill3, four robotic dexterous manipulation tasks from the Adroit benchmark, and three image generation tasks, namely inpainting, super-resolution, and deblurring, using the ImageNet-128 and CelebA-HQ-256 datasets. Our findings show that our framework improves sample quality and guidance stability across all tasks, without imposing any additional overhead.

摘要（中文）：引导方法是扩散模型中引导生成过程的重要工具，能够提升随机机器人控制器的泛化能力，并实现高质量的受控图像合成。尽管流匹配与扩散之间存在很强的相似性，但将引导集成到流匹配模型中仍颇具挑战。近期研究提出了面向流匹配的通用引导框架，然而这些框架直接沿用扩散引导方法，可能表现出不稳定性。在本工作中，我们从理论上分析了流匹配中的引导机制，并表明将基于扩散的引导直接迁移至流匹配会破坏训练过程中使用的耦合分布，从而削弱对采样精度的控制能力。基于这一认识，我们提出了耦合引导（Coupled Guidance），这是一种针对流匹配的专用引导机制，从几何视角出发，充分利用流匹配训练固有的耦合结构。为验证所提方法的有效性，我们在基于ManiSkill3的自定义机器人避障任务、Adroit基准中的四项机器人灵巧操作任务，以及使用ImageNet-128和CelebA-HQ-256数据集的三个图像生成任务（即图像修复、超分辨率和去模糊）上进行了大量实验。实验结果表明，我们的框架在所有任务中均提升了样本质量和引导稳定性，且无需增加任何额外开销。

Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles Manipulation

flow matching robot policies binary feasibility oracle constraint satisfaction safe manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于二元可行性预言机的可微安全保护机制，用于流匹配机器人策略，在推理时修正不安全动作并在训练时提供约束感知信号，在障碍物感知操作中实现100%约束满足。

TLDR: The paper introduces an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for flow-matching robot policies that corrects unsafe actions during inference and provides constraint-aware learning signals during training, achieving 100% constraint satisfaction in obstacle-aware manipulation.

Abstract: Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. Experiments on obstacle-aware robotic manipulation demonstrate 100% constraint satisfaction while preserving task performance.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型日益依赖基于流的动作生成来实现通用操作，然而所生成的动作并不能保证满足关节限位、碰撞规避等物理约束。当可行集无法用解析方式描述，只能通过黑箱可行性判定器获取时，这一问题尤为棘手。我们针对这一实际中的仅含判定器的场景展开研究，并提出一种面向安全流匹配机器人策略的判定器引导可微分安全防护机制。该防护机制在前向传播中利用二元可行性查询修正不安全的更新，同时在后向传播中提取局部边界信息以提供考虑约束的学习信号。结合离散时间流匹配，该防护机制在训练和推理阶段均被使用，从而在无需显式或可微分约束模型的情况下实现前向—后向对齐的策略学习。在考虑障碍物的机器人操作实验上，该方法在保持任务性能的同时实现了100%的约束满足率。

Authors: Jianming Ma, Rongjun Jin, Yizhi Chen, Yue Gao

LOGIV: Graph-Verified Execution with Causal Local Repair for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks Manipulation

graph engineering condition-support edges resource-ordering edges dependency tracing local repair

简要说明：LOGIV 是一个基于图的执行框架，用于长时域机器人任务，在执行过程中验证和修复物理条件，提升了双臂和真实机器人基准的成功率。

TLDR: LOGIV is a graph-based execution framework for long-horizon robot tasks that verifies and repairs physical conditions during execution, improving success rates on dual-arm and real-robot benchmarks.

Abstract: Agentic robots must turn a high-level goal into actions while keeping the physical conditions needed for future steps valid. A completed action does not ensure that its effects will persist: a later disturbance can invalidate support that the remaining plan still assumes. We present LOGIV, a graph engineering framework for agentic robot execution that uses an explicit task graph to connect symbolic planning, observation-based verification, and embodied action. LOGIV compiles a validated plan into condition-support and resource-ordering edges, checks their physical validity during execution, and uses dependency tracing to determine what must be restored after a failure. Repair is constrained by retained unfinished actions, and the combined continuation is symbolically validated before execution resumes. The framework operates above existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Model (WAM) policies without adding trainable components. Across 20 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin~V2 and BiCoord with three execution backbones, LOGIV improves mean task success without injected disturbances by 10.67 and 15.33 percentage points, respectively. Under predefined perturbations, it achieves higher task completion and condition restoration than three adapted recovery baselines for every backbone on both benchmarks. On three real-robot tasks, successful trials increase from 12/30 to 17/30. These results support explicit, continuously checked task dependencies as a practical interface for reliable agentic robot execution.

摘要（中文）：智能体机器人必须将高层目标转化为实际行动，同时确保未来步骤所需的物理条件持续有效。一个已完成的动作并不能保证其效果会持续存在：后续的干扰可能使剩余计划仍然依赖的支撑条件失效。我们提出了LOGIV，一个面向智能体机器人执行的图工程框架，利用显式任务图将符号规划、基于观测的验证和具身动作相连接。LOGIV将验证通过的规划编译为条件支撑边和资源排序边，在执行过程中检查其物理有效性，并通过依赖追踪确定故障后必须恢复的内容。修复过程受保留的未完成动作约束，并在恢复执行前对组合续接方案进行符号验证。该框架运行在现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）策略之上，无需添加可训练组件。在来自RoboTwin~V2和BiCoord的20项双臂任务中，使用三种执行骨干，LOGIV在无注入干扰情况下分别将平均任务成功率提升了10.67和15.33个百分点。在预设扰动条件下，LOGIV在两个基准测试的所有执行骨干上均实现了比三种自适应恢复基线更高的任务完成率和条件恢复率。在三项真实机器人任务中，成功试验从12/30提升至17/30。这些结果支持将显式且持续检查的任务依赖关系作为可靠智能体机器人执行的实际接口。

Authors: Enqiao Lu, Yuxiang Xie, Xingrui Yu, Yuyang Wang, Yipeng Gu, Zhenglin Wan, Pengfei Zhou, Wangbo Zhao, Yang You, Yuxiang Gao, Ivor Tsang

Humanoid Dodgeball: Learning Fast Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Motions for Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

reinforcement learning humanoid robot dynamic obstacle avoidance motion priors whole-body control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于人形机器人的强化学习框架，使其能够快速躲避动态障碍物，通过威胁感知奖励塑形和多方向对抗性运动先验实现全身敏捷规避动作，并在仿真和真实硬件上验证了有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid robots to perform agile, whole-body evasive maneuvers against fast-moving obstacles, using threat-aware reward shaping and adversarial motion priors, with results in simulation and on real hardware.

Abstract: Humanoids have become increasingly agile and capable in real-world environments. To operate safely in dynamic scenarios, they must rapidly evade fast-moving obstacles while maintaining stability and physically feasible whole-body motion. Learning such behaviors remains challenging due to the high-dimensional dynamics of humanoid systems and the need to jointly balance reactive obstacle avoidance, motion naturalness, and control robustness. In this work, we present Humanoid Dodgeball, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for agile dynamic obstacle avoidance in humanoids. Our method enables highly dynamic whole-body evasive maneuvers against incoming projectiles through threat-aware reward shaping, while multiple direction-specific adversarial motion priors regularize the learned behaviors toward stable and diverse human-like motions. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves dynamic obstacle avoidance performance across diverse obstacle speeds and launch distances, while preserving robust and physically plausible humanoid motions.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人已在真实环境中变得越来越敏捷和能力强。为了在动态场景中安全运行，它们必须快速躲避快速移动的障碍物，同时保持稳定性和物理可行的全身运动。由于人形系统的高维动力学特性，以及需要同时平衡反应式避障、运动自然性和控制鲁棒性，学习此类行为仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了Humanoid Dodgeball，一种用于人形机器人敏捷动态避障的强化学习（RL）框架。我们的方法通过威胁感知奖励塑形，使机器人能够针对飞来的抛射物执行高度动态的全身规避动作，同时多个方向特定的对抗运动先验将学习到的行为正则化，使其趋向稳定且多样的人类似运动。大量仿真和硬件实验表明，所提出的框架在不同障碍物速度和发射距离下显著提升了动态避障性能，同时保持了鲁棒且物理合理的人形运动。

Authors: Aoqian Zhang, Chunzheng Wang, Haoran Chen, Annan Tang, Cheng Xiang, Fan Shi, Shuzhi Sam Ge

How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function AutonomousDriving

classifier-free guidance action-value function Q-adaptive guidance driving simulator end-to-end driving

简要说明：本文提出CoC-CFG，通过在VLA策略的上下文与去除推理片段的上下文之间应用分类器无引导，并将引导权重视为通过Q自适应引导测量的动作值函数，以提升驾驶性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces CoC-CFG, a method that applies classifier-free guidance between a VLA policy's context with and without its reasoning trace, treating the guidance weight as a measured action-value function via Q-adaptive guidance to improve driving performance.

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.

摘要（中文）：推理型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略先写出一段推理轨迹，再从中解码动作。错误的轨迹会导致错误的动作，甚至看似正确的轨迹也可能误导规划。现有的补救措施追问推理是否正确。我们追问的是：它应当以多强的程度进行引导。CoC-CFG在策略的上下文与去掉推理片段后的同一上下文之间应用无分类器引导。每个欧拉步一个权重来衰减或放大推理，w=1时恢复原始策略。我们将该权重的选择视为一个马尔可夫决策过程，其动作价值是实测的，而非自举估计的。在专家冻结且噪声固定的条件下，对一步施加某个权重并在当前控制器下完成规划，会精确返回该权重的价值。Q-自适应引导用小规模评价器拟合这些价值，并以保守方式改进控制器。在Alpasim驾驶模拟器中，它在开环下优于所有固定权重和在线强化学习（SAC、GRPO），在闭环下通过300个场景中的262个，而原始策略为252个。在Waymo端到端驾驶基准的留出帧上，其前三个阶段优于所有固定权重、四种自适应引导方法、SAC和GRPO。在隐藏测试集上，冻结的Alpamayo 1.5配合基于规则的相机与车辆转换以及Q-自适应引导，在已发表方法中创下新的最优结果：评分者反馈得分8.135159，而最佳已发表方法为8.079。

Authors: Dabin Seo, Eunhyek Joa

Surrogate Uncertainty for Black-box Visual Grounding Manipulation

visual grounding uncertainty quantification black-box VLM robot manipulation Bayesian surrogate

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对黑盒VLM视觉定位的代理贝叶斯不确定性估计器，使机器人能够在自信行动与信息收集之间权衡，并在真实Fetch机器人的开放世界指令中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a surrogate Bayesian uncertainty estimator for black-box VLM-based visual grounding, enabling robots to trade off confident action and information gathering, validated on real Fetch robot open-world instructions.

Abstract: Visual grounding is crucial for robots to understand language instructions with visual observations. This paper addresses the problem of visual grounding uncertainties, where a robot uses a black-box vision-language model (VLM) to ground free-form natural-language instructions to target objects. Prevailing methods derive uncertainty from the VLM itself. Yet, outputs of the VLM, e.g., generated uncertainties, are from the same parameters and structures producing the predictions, and inherit the bias. We give a formal Bayesian definition of the problem that treats the VLM prediction as an observation. An external surrogate Bayesian model then quantifies per-query uncertainty over a local neighborhood of a held-out calibration set, decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components. A hierarchical retrieval across input modalities realizes a compact joint-space neighborhood, mitigating the curse of dimensionality. The estimator further integrates with conformal prediction or model-based planning for active visual grounding, where robots are allowed to take verbal or physical actions to ground targets. Across grounding benchmarks and state-of-the-art VLMs, it consistently improves both calibration and task performance. On a real Fetch robot under open-world instructions, it enables principled trade-offs between confident action and information gathering, substantially improving robustness.

摘要（中文）：视觉基础对于机器人通过视觉观察来理解语言指令至关重要。本文针对视觉基础中的不确定性问题展开研究，其中机器人利用黑盒视觉语言模型（VLM）将自由形式的自然语言指令映射到目标物体上。现有方法通常从VLM自身推导不确定性，然而VLM的输出（如生成的不确定性）与预测结果源自相同的参数和结构，因而继承了其内在偏差。本文对该问题给出了形式化的贝叶斯定义，将VLM的预测视为一种观测。一个外部替代贝叶斯模型在保留校准集的局部邻域内对每次查询的不确定性进行量化，并将其分解为偶然不确定性和认知不确定性两个组成部分。通过跨输入模态的分层检索，实现了紧凑的联合空间邻域构建，有效缓解了维度灾难问题。该估计器进一步与保形预测或基于模型的规划相结合，用于主动视觉基础，使机器人能够通过语言或物理动作来定位目标。在多个基础基准测试和先进的VLM上，该方法一致地提升了校准效果和任务性能。在真实Fetch机器人上面对开放世界指令时，该方法实现了自信行动与信息收集之间的原则性权衡，显著增强了系统的鲁棒性。

Authors: Hanbo Zhang, Tianrun Hu, Cedar Site Bai, Anxing Xiao, David Hsu

Kinematic-Tactile Aligned Dexterous Retargeting with Contact Wrench Space Alignment Manipulation

dexterous manipulation retargeting contact wrench space tactile alignment human demonstration

简要说明：本文提出一种分层三阶段灵巧重定向框架，利用物体中心接触力旋量空间对齐人手与机器人手的运动学和触觉信息，在真实机器人实验中实现了高重放成功率和更高的力旋量传递保真度。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hierarchical three-stage framework for dexterous retargeting that aligns both kinematic and tactile information between human and robot hands using object-centric contact wrench space, demonstrating high replay success rates and improved wrench transfer fidelity in real robot experiments.

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide a natural and scalable source of data for learning dexterous manipulation policies. However, existing retargeting methods primarily transfer human kinematics, while the tactile information underlying physical interaction is rarely preserved across embodiments. To address this limitation, we present a hierarchical three-stage framework for kinematic-tactile aligned dexterous retargeting. We use object-centric contact wrench space as a physical representation for tactile alignment between human and robot hands. The framework first aligns hand kinematics and contact geometry, and then constructs a human wrench support profile from tactile forces and contact geometry. Robot fingertip force targets are subsequently optimized to cover the human wrench support and converted into joint position corrections, yielding directly replayable robot hand trajectories. We evaluate the framework in simulation and real robot experiments across three pouring conditions. In the real robot experiments, our method achieves a 96.7\% replay success rate and higher wrench transfer fidelity than representative retargeting baselines. The framework enables physically grounded transfer of kinematic and tactile information from human demonstrations to robot hands, providing a path toward scalable learning of contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

摘要（中文）：人类示范为学习灵巧操作策略提供了自然且可扩展的数据来源。然而，现有的重定向方法主要迁移人体运动学信息，而物理交互背后的触觉信息在不同 embodiment 之间很少被保留。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种分层三阶段框架，用于运动学-触觉对齐的灵巧重定向。我们以物体为中心的接触力旋量空间作为人体手与机器人手之间触觉对齐的物理表征。该框架首先对齐手部运动学与接触几何，然后基于触觉力和接触几何构建人体力旋量支撑轮廓。随后，机器人指尖力目标被优化以覆盖人体力旋量支撑，并转换为关节位置修正量，从而生成可直接回放的机器人手部轨迹。我们在仿真和真实机器人实验中，对三种倾倒场景下的框架进行了评估。在真实机器人实验中，我们的方法达到了96.7%的回放成功率，并比代表性重定向基线方法具有更高的力旋量传递保真度。该框架实现了将人类示范中的运动学和触觉信息以物理可解释的方式迁移至机器人手部，为接触丰富的灵巧操作的可扩展学习提供了一条路径。

Authors: Xinyuan He, Ziheng Xu, Yueyuan Chen, Yufan Ye, Yuanshuo Tan, Huiming Pan, Jianjun Meng, Shuo Jiang, Peter B. Shull

SimTO-Robust: Automated Design of Soft Grippers Robust to Grasp Pose and Object Geometry Manipulation

soft gripper topology optimization robust grasping pick-and-place simulation-driven design

简要说明：SimTO-Robust 将仿真驱动的拓扑优化扩展为显式优化软体抓手的形态，以应对物体几何形状和抓取位姿的鲁棒性，并通过物理实验证明这些抓手在有干扰的拾放任务中优于专用和基线设计。

TLDR: SimTO-Robust extends simulation-driven topology optimization to explicitly optimize soft gripper morphology for robustness across object geometries and grasp poses, and demonstrates through physical experiments that these grippers outperform specialized and baseline designs in pick-and-place tasks with disturbances.

Abstract: Robotic grippers operating in unstructured environments must robustly grasp objects of different shapes and sizes despite perception and positioning errors. Soft grippers that can achieve this robustness through intelligent mechanical design rather than sophisticated control software offer a promising solution. However, no existing computational design framework explicitly optimises soft gripper morphology for robustness across object geometries and grasp poses. We introduce SimTO-Robust, a generalisation of simulation-driven topology optimisation (SimTO) that simulates grasps across multiple objects and poses and aggregates their contact forces to guide gripper morphology optimisation. We generate 6,646 designs and physically evaluate 24 of them alongside 10 specialised SimTO designs, two rigid baseline grippers, and a baseline generalist soft gripper produced using conventional topology optimisation. All 37 grippers are tested in a pick-and-place task involving five feature-rich objects and six grasp poses, with external disturbances of increasing magnitude applied during the task. On average, SimTO-Robust designs complete pick-and-place more reliably than specialised SimTO designs and the rigid baselines. The best SimTO-Robust designs also withstood more of the applied disturbances than any other tested gripper. These results show that incorporating diverse grasp conditions into simulation-driven topology optimisation is a simple and effective approach to improving real-world soft gripper robustness. More broadly, they show that robust robotic grasping can be achieved through intelligent mechanical design rather than sophisticated sensing and control.

摘要（中文）：在非结构化环境中操作的机器人夹爪，即便面临感知与定位误差，也必须稳健地抓取不同形状和尺寸的物体。通过智能机械设计而非复杂控制软件来实现这种稳健性的软体夹爪，提供了一种颇具前景的解决方案。然而，现有计算设计框架中尚无专门针对软体夹爪形态进行优化，以兼顾物体几何形状和抓取位姿鲁棒性的方法。为此，我们提出SimTO-Robust，这是仿真驱动拓扑优化（SimTO）的一种推广形式，它模拟跨多个物体和位姿的抓取过程，并聚合其接触力以引导夹爪形态优化。我们生成了6，646个设计方案，并对其中的24个进行了物理评估，同时与10个专用SimTO设计、两个刚性基准夹爪以及一个采用传统拓扑优化生成的通用软体基准夹爪进行了对比。全部37个夹爪在一个拾放任务中进行了测试，该任务涉及五个特征丰富的物体和六种抓取位姿，并在任务过程中施加了逐渐增大的外部扰动。平均而言，SimTO-Robust设计在拾放任务中的完成可靠性优于专用SimTO设计和刚性基准夹爪。最佳SimTO-Robust设计在承受所施加扰动方面也优于任何其他测试夹爪。这些结果表明，将多样化抓取条件纳入仿真驱动拓扑优化，是提升实际软体夹爪鲁棒性的一种简单而有效的方法。更广泛地说，它们证明了稳健的机器人抓取可以通过智能机械设计而非复杂的感知与控制来实现。

Authors: Kurt Enkera, Joshua Pinskier, Marcus Gallagher, David Howard

From Reasoning to Action: Consequence-Grounded Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

vision-language-action models consequence-grounded alignment embodied chain of thought reward-guided optimization manipulation

简要说明：CoRAct 提出了一个基于后果对齐的视觉-语言-动作模型框架，通过奖励引导的噪声优化，显式地使动作生成与预期运动和空间路径点一致，从而提升仿真和真实操作任务的成功率与泛化能力。

TLDR: CoRAct introduces a consequence-grounded alignment framework for Vision-Language-Action models, explicitly optimizing action generation to match intended movements and spatial waypoints through reward-guided noise optimization, improving task success and generalization in simulated and real-world manipulation.

Abstract: Reasoning informs decision-making by connecting intended actions with their expected consequences. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate embodied chains of thought (ECoTs) to guide action generation. However, such guidance remains implicit, as actions are conditioned on ECoTs rather than explicitly optimized to align with them. We introduce CoRAct, a consequence-grounded reasoning-to-action alignment framework that explicitly aligns reasoning and action through reward-guided optimization in action noise space. CoRAct formulates two physically grounded ECoT components as verifiable signals: movement specifies intended motion, while waypoints encode expected spatial consequences. A unified Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction. For candidate actions generated from sampled noise, CoRAct computes alignment rewards based on movement consistency and agreement between predicted outcomes and specified waypoints. These rewards guide group-relative optimization of the initial noise distribution, steering action generation toward consistency with intended actions and expected consequences. Experiments across RoboCasa, VLABench, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements in task success, generalization, and reasoning-execution alignment over strong ECoT-based VLA baselines. CoRAct also grounds externally provided ECoTs in executable behavior, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel scenarios by leveraging knowledge from powerful vision-language models. Project page and dataset: https://onlyxingxingzyx.github.io/CoRAct/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 推理通过将预期动作与其预期后果相连接来为决策提供依据。近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型引入具身思维链（ECoT）来指导动作生成。然而，这种指导仍然是隐式的，因为动作只是以ECoT为条件，而没有被显式优化以与其对齐。 我们提出CoRAct，一种以后果为基础的推理到动作对齐框架，通过动作噪声空间中的奖励引导优化，显式地对齐推理与动作。CoRAct将两个具有物理基础的ECoT组件形式化为可验证信号：运动指定预期运动，而路径点编码预期空间后果。一个统一的Transformer混合模型联合建模ECoT推理、动作生成以及以动作为条件的未来预测。对于从采样噪声生成的候选动作，CoRAct基于运动一致性以及预测结果与指定路径点之间的一致性来计算对齐奖励。这些奖励引导初始噪声分布的组相对优化，从而推动动作生成与预期动作和预期后果保持一致。 在RoboCasa、VLABench和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，相较于强大的基于ECoT的VLA基线，该方法在任务成功率、泛化能力和推理-执行对齐方面均有提升。CoRAct还将外部提供的ECoT落地为可执行行为，通过利用强大视觉-语言模型中的知识，实现对新颖场景的零样本适应。 项目页面与数据集：https://onlyxingxingzyx.github.io/CoRAct/

Authors: Yixue Zhang, Wenke Xia, Kun Wu, Wenbo Yu, Pei Ren, Junnan Nie, Di Hu, Zhengping Che, Chang Liu

Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning Manipulation

action chunking movement primitive imitation learning bimanual manipulation smooth trajectory

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于运动基元的轨迹表示方法用于模仿学习中的动作分块，通过构造平滑轨迹并给出块间边界不连续性的闭式修正，在真实双臂平台上验证了有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation for action chunking in imitation learning, which smooths robot trajectories by construction and provides a closed-form correction for boundary discontinuities between chunks, validated on real bimanual hardware.

Abstract: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior. The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

摘要（中文）：模仿学习已成为基于视觉的机器人策略中广泛采用的方法，这得益于其概念上的简洁性、可扩展性以及利用大规模数据集的能力。随着这些策略的能力不断增强，动作分块已成为其标准接口。在每个决策步骤中，策略会一次性输出多个未来动作。从扩散策略到大型视觉-语言-动作模型，各类骨干网络均采用这一机制。无论产生分块的骨干网络是哪一种，其时间结构仅被隐式学习。因此，所指令的轨迹在分块内部及分块之间均显得生硬不连贯。在实际硬件上，这表现为可见的振动以及跟随器速度限制的反复饱和。我们通过将基于运动基元的轨迹表示整合到动作分块中来解决这一问题。具体而言，一条轨迹段被表示为光滑基函数的线性组合，从而在构造上保证轨迹平滑，同时不改变策略架构、训练目标及推理流程。该表示还提供了一种闭式推理时校正方法，用于消除第二个生硬来源。我们对预测系数施加条件约束，使得新分块通过前一个分块最后指令动作处的路径点。该校正无需重新训练，并且与异步实时分块不同，它适用于一次性查询的策略。我们将其分别实例化在一次性的ACT骨干网络和迭代式的DiT骨干网络上，并在仿真环境及真实双臂ALOHA平台上进行评估。该表示使一次性骨干网络的分块内生硬程度降低了一个数量级，使迭代式骨干网络降低了2.4倍，同时任务成功率在统计上非劣于原有方法。条件约束则消除了73%-84%的边界不连续性，且每步计算开销可忽略不计。

Authors: Shota Nomura, Takayuki Osa, Yasuhiro Kato, Kazuki Ota, Naoki Shitanda, Tatsuya Harada

Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory VLN

embodied navigation hybrid action space persistent memory active interaction vision-language navigation

简要说明：EvoLife 是一个统一的具身导航框架，具备混合动作空间、主动交互和持久空间记忆，在视觉语言导航、物体导航、交互式实例导航和连续多任务导航等基准上取得近乎完美的成功率。

TLDR: EvoLife is a unified embodied navigation harness with hybrid action space, active interaction, and persistent spatial memory, achieving near-perfect success rates across VLN, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation benchmarks.

Abstract: Giving embodied agents the freedom to act autonomously, initiate interactions, and understand their surroundings through experience is a step toward bringing them to life in the physical world. Realizing this vision requires action, interaction, and memory to work together, so that each encounter can inform current decisions and contribute experience for future tasks. We present EvoLife, a unified navigation harness that enables a multimodal embodied agent to choose how to move, when to ask, and what experience to carry forward. Its hybrid action space supports waypoint navigation, local discrete adjustments, pixel-based navigation, and object-directed navigation. Active interaction allows the agent to seek clarification or assistance when it encounters ambiguity or difficulty, while persistent spatial memory binds observations and dialogue to places, retaining useful experience to guide subsequent visits. We evaluate eight benchmarks across four task families: vision-language navigation, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation. With an average of only 1.87 active interactions per episode, our method achieves a first-visit success rate (SR) of 100% across four 100-episode sets spanning vision-language navigation and object navigation. Complete-sequence SR reaches 98% on 50 LHPR-VLN sequences and 94% on 50 GOAT-Bench sequences. In the R2R revisit setting, success weighted by path length (SPL) increases from 82.23% to 93.31% with retained experience. Multi-day physical navigation further demonstrates exploration, proactive help-seeking, and revisiting remembered places. Together, these results advance the vision of bringing embodied agents to life through autonomous action, proactive interaction, and the accumulation and reuse of experience.

摘要（中文）：赋予具身智能体自主行动、主动发起交互并通过经验理解周围环境的自由，是将其带入物理世界并赋予生命的重要一步。要实现这一愿景，需要行动、交互与记忆协同运作，使每一次经历都能为当前决策提供依据，并为未来任务积累经验。我们提出 EvoLife，一个统一的导航框架，使多模态具身智能体能够自主选择如何移动、何时询问以及携带哪些经验继续前行。其混合动作空间支持航点导航、局部离散调整、基于像素的导航以及目标导向导航。主动交互使智能体在遇到歧义或困难时能够寻求澄清或帮助，而持久空间记忆则将观察和对话绑定到具体地点，保留有用经验以指导后续访问。我们在四个任务族共八个基准上进行了评估：视觉语言导航、物体导航、交互式实例导航和连续多任务导航。在每回合平均仅 1.87 次主动交互的情况下，我们的方法在涵盖视觉语言导航和物体导航的四组各 100 回合的测试中实现了 100% 的首次访问成功率（SR）。完整序列 SR 在 50 条 LHPR-VLN 序列上达到 98%，在 50 条 GOAT-Bench 序列上达到 94%。在 R2R 重访设置中，借助保留的经验，按路径长度加权的成功率（SPL）从 82.23% 提升至 93.31%。多日物理导航进一步展示了探索、主动求助以及对记忆地点的重访能力。综上所述，这些结果推进了通过自主行动、主动交互以及经验的积累与重用来赋予具身智能体生命的愿景。

Authors: Kai Sheng, Liuyi Wang, Jinlong Li, Haojie Dai, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen

ScheduleGen: Demonstration Generation via Skill Scheduling for Multi-Arm Imitation Learning Manipulation

multi-arm manipulation demonstration generation planning and scheduling imitation learning sim-to-real

简要说明：ScheduleGen 是一种集成的规划与调度算法，用于生成安全且成功的多臂演示，以支持模仿学习，在仿真和真实机器人任务中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: ScheduleGen is an integrated planning and scheduling algorithm that generates safe and successful multi-arm demonstrations for imitation learning, achieving high success in simulation and real-world robot tasks.

Abstract: Multi-arm robot platforms, including bimanual and humanoid robots, have the capability to complete tasks with lower cycle times than single-arm systems, but they are more difficult to safely control due to the presence of multi-arm constraints. The paradigm of training generalist robot policies from massive datasets is a promising approach to address general-purpose multi-arm manipulation, but the acquisition of large multi-arm manipulation datasets remains a bottleneck. Automated demonstration generation can alleviate this burden by synthesizing new demonstrations from a handful of source demonstrations, but existing algorithms ignore multi-arm constraints and as a result often induce unsafe and unsuccessful behaviors. We address this limitation by introducing ScheduleGen, an integrated planning & scheduling algorithm for multi-arm demonstration generation. We evaluate ScheduleGen on 28 simulation task variants, including seven externally authored RoboDojo tasks and settings inaccessible to prior systems; it achieves 79.6% mean data-generation success and trains policies with 65.5% mean success. ScheduleGen policies outperform those trained on a state-of-the-art data generation baseline, and achieve 50-80% success across eight real-world variants through zero-shot sim-to-real and real-to-sim-to-real transfer. Videos and more at: https://schedulegen.github.io/

摘要（中文）：多臂机器人平台，包括双臂机器人和人形机器人，能够在比单臂系统更短的工作周期内完成任务，但由于多臂约束的存在，其安全控制难度更大。从大规模数据集中训练通用机器人策略的范式，是解决通用多臂操作问题的一种有前景的方法，但大规模多臂操作数据集的获取仍是瓶颈。自动演示生成可以通过从少量源演示中合成新演示来缓解这一负担，但现有算法忽略了多臂约束，因此常常导致不安全且失败的行为。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ScheduleGen，一种用于多臂演示生成的集成规划与调度算法。我们在28个仿真任务变体上评估了ScheduleGen，其中包括七个外部编写的RoboDojo任务以及先前系统无法访问的设置；它实现了79.6%的平均数据生成成功率，并训练出平均成功率为65.5%的策略。基于ScheduleGen的策略优于在先进数据生成基线上训练的策略，并通过零样本仿真到现实以及现实到仿真再到现实的迁移，在八个真实世界变体上实现了50-80%的成功率。更多视频与信息请访问：https://schedulegen.github.io/

Authors: Neel Jawale, Stephan Pleines, Soha Pouya, Yuke Zhu, Ajay Mandlekar, Caelan Garrett

UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection Manipulation

bimanual manipulation data collection SLAM VLA policy open-source hardware

简要说明：UMI-Live 是一个全栈开源的双臂数据采集系统，集成了相机、LiDAR-惯性传感、板载计算和电源，用于野外演示采集，并具有异步SLAM管线和VLA策略训练支持，通过微调π0.5和MolmoAct2验证。

TLDR: UMI-Live is a full-stack open-source bimanual data collection system that integrates camera, LiDAR-inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power for in-the-wild demonstration collection, with an asynchronous SLAM pipeline and support for VLA policy training, validated by fine-tuning π0.5 and MolmoAct2.

Abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/10, respectively on a bimanual pick-and-place task. Furthermore, we release 40 hours of UMI-Live data across three tasks, and complete hardware designs, software, and reproduction guides at our $\href{https://umi-live.github.io/}{\text{project website}}$.

摘要（中文）：通用操作接口（UMI）设备允许人类专家在不远程操控实体机器人的情况下演示机器人学习任务。然而，将这些演示用作训练数据仍需要一致的硬件配置、标定和数据处理流程。我们提出了UMI-Live，一个用于野外数据采集的全栈开源双臂UMI系统。我们设计了定制化的UMI-Live硬件，集成了相机与LiDAR-惯性传感、机载计算和供电功能，且无需采集环境中的外部跟踪设备或标定。我们实现了一个简洁的用户界面用于记录数据，同时异步流水线并行执行SLAM重建，并发布可直接用于训练的数据集。我们还发布了支持双YAM遥操作以及VLA策略训练与推理的软件。我们通过微调$π_{0.5}$和MolmoAct2来验证UMI-Live的数据质量，在双臂拾取-放置任务中分别取得了10/10和8/10的成功率。此外，我们发布了涵盖三个任务共计40小时的UMI-Live数据，以及完整的硬件设计、软件和复现指南，详见我们的$\href{https://umi-live.github.io/}{\text{项目网站}}$。

Authors: Govind Velamoor, Adrian Lin, Sam Jung, Spencer Mateega, Brandon Y. Yang, Amish Sethi

Utility-WAM: Correcting Future-Induced Action Changes WorldModel

World Action Models future-conditioned control negative transfer residual adapter video generation gating

简要说明：Utility-WAM 分析了世界动作模型（WAM）中由未来视觉预测引发的负迁移失效模式，并提出残差适配器与预生成门控来修正动作偏移、跳过冗余视频生成，从而提升成功率并降低延迟。

TLDR: Utility-WAM diagnoses a future-induced negative transfer failure mode in World Action Models for robot manipulation and corrects it with a residual adapter plus a pre-generation gate that skips unnecessary video generation, improving success and cutting latency.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) can condition robot actions on generated visual futures, but this additional context is neither cost-free nor uniformly beneficial. We examine what a predicted future actually changes: the action delta $Δa$ between the future-conditioned and future-free execution paths of the same model. Under a shared WAM checkpoint, this delta barely shifts average benchmark success ($+0.8$ points on LIBERO, $-0.8$ on RoboTwin~2.0), while generating visual futures increases inference latency by 1.7--1.9$\times$. These aggregate metrics conceal a concentrated failure mode that we term \emph{future-induced negative transfer}: while predictive deltas benefit long-horizon tasks ($+2.4$ points on LIBERO-Long) and remain negligible on most routine manipulations, they induce severe degradation on precision tasks---with \emph{Press Stapler} and \emph{Place Can Basket} losing 54.0 and 34.0 points, recurring as top failure modes across independently trained WAM variants. We introduce \textbf{Utility-WAM} for in-place correction of future-conditioned control. Its primary learning component is a residual adapter that repairs future-induced velocity deltas under a frozen shared WAM by aligning them with ground-truth dynamic guidance and penalizing excess error beyond the future-free baseline. The adapter selectively eliminates the majority of severe task drops (reducing losses to 6.0 and 14.0 points) while preserving long-horizon foresight. To eliminate superfluous video computation, a lightweight pre-generation gate reuses counterfactual action outcomes to selectively bypass video generation on 75.5\% of RoboTwin queries, cutting latency by 38\% while improving average success to 93.3\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and 98.9\% on LIBERO. On physical bimanual manipulation across three real-world tasks, Utility-WAM succeeds in 53 of 60 trials, compared to 43 for FAST-WAM.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）能够以生成的视觉未来为条件来驱动机器人动作，但这种额外的上下文既非无代价，也非普遍有益。我们考察了预测未来实际改变了什么：同一模型在未来条件执行路径与无未来执行路径之间的动作增量 $Δa$。在共享的 WAM 检查点下，该增量几乎不改变平均基准成功率（LIBERO 上 +0.8 分，RoboTwin~2.0 上 -0.8 分），而生成视觉未来会使推理延迟增加 1.7--1.9$\times$。这些聚合指标掩盖了一种集中的失败模式，我们将其称为\emph{未来诱导负迁移}：预测增量有利于长时程任务（LIBERO-Long 上 +2.4 分），且在大多数常规操作中可忽略不计，但在精密任务上会导致严重退化——\emph{Press Stapler} 和 \emph{Place Can Basket} 分别损失 54.0 和 34.0 分，并在独立训练的 WAM 变体中反复成为主要失败模式。我们提出了 \textbf{Utility-WAM}，用于对未来条件控制进行原地校正。其主要学习组件是一个残差适配器，它在冻结的共享 WAM 下修复未来诱导的速度增量，方法是将它们与真实动态引导对齐，并惩罚超出无未来基线的过量误差。该适配器选择性地消除了大多数严重任务性能下降（将损失降至 6.0 和 14.0 分），同时保留了长时程前瞻能力。为消除多余的视频计算，一个轻量级预生成门控复用反事实动作结果，在 RoboTwin 查询中选择性地跳过 75.5\% 的视频生成，将延迟降低 38\%，同时将平均成功率提升至 RoboTwin~2.0 上的 93.3\% 和 LIBERO 上的 98.9\%。在三个真实世界任务的物理双臂操作中，Utility-WAM 在 60 次试验中成功 53 次，而 FAST-WAM 为 43 次。

Authors: Feihong Zhang, Xi Lin, Yulong Shi, Zuxing Lu, Yanghong Mei, Zhaopeng Gu, Tingyu Yuan, Zihao Liang, Yinuo Wang, Zhaowen Li

SONIC-K1: Porting a Universal Humanoid Motion Tracker to a Small Humanoid on a Single GPU HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body motion tracking humanoid robot single GPU training MuJoCo simulation open-weights policy

简要说明：本文提出了SONIC-K1，一个针对Booster K1人形机器人的开源全身运动跟踪器，在单GPU上从头训练。它在仿真中实现了广泛的运动跟踪能力，在真实机器人上实现了上半身跟踪，但步进和转身仍不可靠。

TLDR: This paper presents SONIC-K1, an open-weights whole-body motion tracker for the Booster K1 humanoid, trained from scratch on a single GPU. It achieves broad motion-tracking capability in simulation and real-robot upper-body tracking, though stepping and turning remain unreliable.

Abstract: We present SONIC-K1, to our knowledge the first open-weights whole-body motion tracker for the Booster K1 humanoid, obtained by adapting the SONIC framework to this smaller robot. The policy is trained from scratch on a single shared GPU with a small fraction of the compute reported for SONIC. In MuJoCo simulation, it tracks nearly all held-out motion clips and performs well on external benchmarks under SONIC's success criterion. On the real K1, it tracks upper-body and slow motions, while stepping and turning remain less reliable, and simulation experiments show a sensitivity to action latency. These results show broad motion-tracking capability on a modest training budget and point to quantitative hardware evaluation as the main next step. Code, policy weights and evaluation tools are publicly available.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍了SONIC-K1，据我们所知，这是首个面向Booster K1人形机器人的开源全身运动追踪器，通过将SONIC框架适配至该更小型的机器人而实现。该策略在单个共享GPU上从头训练，所消耗的计算资源仅为SONIC报告所用的一小部分。在MuJoCo仿真中，该策略几乎能够追踪所有留出的运动片段，并在SONIC成功标准下的外部基准测试中表现良好。在真实K1机器人上，它能够追踪上半身及慢速运动，而行走与转向的可靠性仍有所欠缺；仿真实验同时表明其对动作延迟较为敏感。这些结果展示了在有限训练预算下实现广泛运动追踪能力的可能性，并指出定量硬件评估是下一步的主要方向。代码、策略权重及评估工具均已公开。

Authors: Kyrylo Kolesnichenko, Jong-Hoon Kim

OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation VLA

vision-language-action model aerial navigation onboard inference sim-to-real transfer action chunking

简要说明：OpenFlyV2提出了一个用于空中机器人的统一机载视觉-语言-动作模型，在资源受限平台上实现语言引导感知、空间推理和连续飞行控制，并支持零样本仿真到真实迁移。

TLDR: OpenFlyV2 introduces a unified onboard vision-language-action model for aerial robots, enabling language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous flight control on resource-constrained platforms, with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain.

摘要（中文）：人类认知灵活地依托共享的感知基础来理解环境、关注被指涉的实体、推理空间关系并采取行动。为空中机器人赋予类似的功能组织仍然具有挑战性，因为现有系统往往针对单一能力进行专门设计，依赖机外计算，或无法在资源受限平台上维持闭环运行。我们提出OpenFlyV2，一种统一的机载视觉-语言-动作架构，利用共享的视觉-语言表征在单一模型中支持语义理解、语言 grounding 感知、空间推理和连续空中控制。一个紧凑的动作专家将共享的多模态上下文转换为短时域飞行航点，而运动感知的时间记忆和动作先验则降低了闭环执行的计算成本。我们构建了\dataset{}，一个基于仿真的数据集，包含约70,000条导航轨迹和60,000对视觉-语言指令-响应对。OpenFlyV2以10 Hz的频率完全在机载条件下使用NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX生成动作块，每块包含12个航点。它实现了从仿真到物理四旋翼飞行的零样本迁移，在没有真实世界空中训练数据的情况下，在四个真实环境中达到48\%的导航成功率。大量结果表明，广泛的视觉-语言能力与连续闭环飞行可以在资源受限的空中平台上共存于单一模型中。代码将公开于https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain。

Authors: Junli Liu, Zhongrui You, Chenhui Li, Zhen Li, Yuyang Tian, Qizhen Chen, Delin Qu, Haoming Song, Dong Wang, Xuelong Li, Zhigang Wang, Bin Zhao

PriorMaskMap: Robust Online Vectorized Map Construction with Biased Priors AutonomousDriving

vectorized map biased priors BEV features nuScenes online mapping

简要说明：PriorMaskMap提出了一种鲁棒的先验引导在线矢量化地图构建框架，通过置信度估计器和双分支设计处理有偏先验地图，在nuScenes上实现了优越的精度和鲁棒性。

TLDR: PriorMaskMap introduces a robust framework for prior-guided online vectorized map construction, using a confidence estimator and dual-branch design to handle biased prior maps. It achieves superior precision and robustness on nuScenes.

Abstract: Online vectorized map construction provides autonomous vehicles with essential, real-time semantic and geometric scene understanding. While leveraging prior maps presents an opportunity to improve accuracy, they are often biased due to outdated information or temporary road changes. Existing methods, which typically treat priors as fully reliable or only consider limited noise patterns, suffer severe performance degradation when these priors are imperfect. To address this, we propose PriorMaskMap, a robust framework for prior-guided vectorized map construction. Its first innovation is a Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE) that evaluates the input rasterized map against current visual observations. It assigns confidence scores to regions classified as reliable, erroneous, or blank, creating a foundational mask that guides two subsequent branches. In one branch, the Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG) selectively filters and embeds both rasterized and vectorized priors to initialize informative queries from trustworthy map structures. In the other, the Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF) module spatially propagates and refines the mask, using the refined version to govern the fusion of BEV features with the prior map, thereby providing rich contextual representations for the map decoder. Evaluation on the nuScenes dataset shows that PriorMaskMap achieves superior mapping precision over existing approaches and exhibits marked robustness when provided with priors containing apparent errors. Our code is released at https://github.com/healenrens/PriorMaskMap.

摘要（中文）：在线矢量化地图构建为自动驾驶车辆提供了关键的实时语义与几何场景理解能力。尽管利用先验地图为提高精度提供了机会，但由于信息过时或临时道路变化，先验地图往往存在偏差。现有方法通常将先验视为完全可靠，或仅考虑有限的噪声模式，当先验不完美时性能会严重下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PriorMaskMap，一种用于先验引导矢量化地图构建的鲁棒框架。其第一个创新是先验感知置信度估计器（PACE），它将输入的光栅化地图与当前视觉观测进行对比评估。它为被分类为可靠、错误或空白区域分配置信度分数，生成一个基础掩码以指导后续两个分支。在一个分支中，双先验查询生成器（DPQG）选择性地过滤并嵌入光栅化和矢量化先验，从可信的地图结构中初始化信息丰富的查询。在另一个分支中，置信度引导先验融合（CGPF）模块对掩码进行空间传播和细化，利用细化后的掩码控制BEV特征与先验地图的融合，从而为地图解码器提供丰富的上下文表示。在nuScenes数据集上的评估表明，PriorMaskMap相比现有方法实现了更优的建图精度，并且在提供包含明显错误的先验时表现出显著的鲁棒性。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/healenrens/PriorMaskMap。

Authors: Haoming Xu, Wei Li, Yu Hu

Cross-Controller Transfer via In-Context Behavior Adaptation Manipulation

cross-controller transfer in-context adaptation generalist robot policies behavioral interaction transformer context encoder

简要说明：本文提出了一种上下文行为适应框架，通过编码指令动作与机器人运动之间的行为交互，使单一机器人策略能够在不同控制器和本体之间迁移。在真实世界操作任务上，该方法显著优于朴素数据池化，并能泛化到未见过的控制器模式和增益。

TLDR: This paper proposes an in-context behavior adaptation framework that allows a single robot policy to transfer across different controllers and embodiments by encoding behavioral interaction between commanded actions and resulting motions. It achieves large gains over naive data pooling on real-world manipulation tasks, including generalization to unseen controller modes and gains.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies increasingly learn from data collected across diverse tasks and embodiments, yet typically assume a single controller for each robot. This assumption limits transfer because different controllers can assign different physical meanings to the same action and may require different strategies to complete a task. We study how to transfer robot data across both embodiments and controllers without allowing conflicting action interpretations to interfere with learning. Our setting spans six controller types as well as variations in controller gains and compliance. We propose a framework that encodes behavioral interaction under a controller through examples of commanded actions and the resulting robot motions. A transformer context encoder summarizes these interactions, allowing a single policy to adapt in context. Across real-world experiments, our method improves average success by 33 percentage points over naive data pooling, achieves 50\% success on unseen controller modes and 52\% on unseen controller gains, and transfers to tasks with limited controller-specific data. On contact-rich tasks such as USB insertion and surface wiping, behavioral interaction context enables the policy to adapt not only its actions but also its strategy. Our results provide a path toward generalist robot policies that can leverage data collected across diverse action interpretations. For more information, visit \href{https://controller-transfer.github.io}{https://controller-transfer.github.io}.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人策略越来越多地从跨不同任务和机器人本体收集的数据中学习，但通常假设每个机器人使用单一控制器。这一假设限制了迁移能力，因为不同控制器可能对相同动作赋予不同的物理含义，并可能要求采用不同策略来完成任务。我们研究如何在跨本体和控制器迁移机器人数据时，避免冲突的动作解释干扰学习。我们的研究范围涵盖六种控制器类型以及控制器增益和柔顺性的变化。我们提出一个框架，通过控制指令动作及其所产生的机器人运动的实例，对控制器下的行为交互进行编码。一个变换器上下文编码器对这些交互进行总结，使单一策略能够根据上下文进行自适应调整。在真实世界实验中，我们的方法相较朴素数据池化方法平均成功率提升33个百分点，在未见过的控制器模式上达到50\%的成功率，在未见过的控制器增益上达到52\%的成功率，并能迁移至控制器特定数据有限的任务。在诸如USB插入和表面擦拭等接触密集任务中，行为交互上下文使策略不仅能调整动作，还能调整其策略本身。我们的研究结果为通用型机器人策略提供了一条路径，使其能够利用跨多种动作解释收集的数据。更多信息请访问\href{https://controller-transfer.github.io}{https://controller-transfer.github.io}。
