Authors: Jiahe Wang, Sultan Haidar Ali, Eric Weissman, Jiefeng Sun

Robotic Data Inoculation Manipulation

data collection shared control residual policy teleoperation offline RL

简要说明：Data Inoculation 是一种共享控制数据采集框架：人类进行遥操作，同时在线训练的残差策略扰动指令，使机器人暴露于更多状态并产生恢复演示，从而提升下游策略性能。

TLDR: Data Inoculation is a shared-control data collection framework where a human teleoperates while an online-trained residual policy perturbs commands, exposing the robot to diverse states and generating recovery demonstrations that improve downstream policy performance.

Abstract: Modern robot learning systems feed on high-quality demonstration data, and their performance hinges on coverage. Without good coverage, small errors compound and the policy can quickly go into out-of-distribution states from which it cannot recover. Yet there is no principled way of collecting high-coverage data, and data collection often relies on heuristic instructions to human operators. Purely online reinforcement learning (RL) explores at the cost of safety and sample efficiency, while DAgger-style interventions require the policy to fail by chance before a human can correct it. In this paper, we ask instead whether we can modify how the robot behaves during data collection to collect more useful data. We propose Data Inoculation (DI), a shared-control framework in which a human provide closed-loop teleoperation commands while a residual policy perturbs these commands. The residual policy is trained online, on the growing dataset, with the same reward-maximizing objective later used for policy extraction, so its perturbations steer data collection toward the deviations a policy trained on the data would make. These perturbations expose the robot to a wider range of states, while the human's continuous corrections provide recovery demonstrations, "inoculating" the dataset against the learner's future mistakes while the human remains in control. On three challenging real-world robotic tasks, DI consistently improves or matches the success rate of policies trained with both behavioral cloning and offline RL, showing DI as an effective data collection strategy for improving downstream policy performance.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 现代机器人学习系统依赖于高质量的示范数据，其性能在很大程度上取决于数据覆盖面。若覆盖面不足，微小误差会不断累积，策略可能迅速进入分布外状态，从而无法恢复。然而，目前尚无系统化的方法用于收集高覆盖率数据，数据采集往往依赖于向人类操作员提供的启发式指令。纯在线强化学习（RL）以牺牲安全性和样本效率为代价进行探索，而DAgger式干预则要求策略在人类能够纠正之前偶然失败。本文转而探讨是否可以通过修改机器人在数据采集过程中的行为方式来收集更有价值的数据。为此，我们提出“数据接种”（Data Inoculation, DI），一种共享控制框架，在该框架中，人类提供闭环遥操作指令，同时一个残差策略对这些指令进行扰动。该残差策略基于不断增长的数据集进行在线训练，并采用与后续策略提取阶段相同的奖励最大化目标，因此其扰动能够将数据采集引导至基于当前数据训练的策略可能产生的偏差方向。这些扰动使机器人暴露于更广泛的状状空间，而人类的持续纠正则提供了恢复示范，从而在人类保持控制的同时，对未来学习者的错误进行“接种”式防御。在三个具有挑战性的真实机器人任务中，DI持续提升或匹配基于行为克隆和离线RL训练策略的成功率，表明DI是一种有效的数据采集策略，可提升下游策略性能。

Authors: Qiyang Li, Zhiyuan Zhou, Charles Xu, Sergey Levine

Self-Supervised Doppler-Guided RF Odometry Other

RF odometry self-supervised Doppler consistency ego-motion estimation range-azimuth frames

简要说明：RFWalk是一个自监督的纯射频里程计框架，通过循环一致性和多普勒一致性损失学习稠密对应关系，并利用鲁棒的SE(2)配准恢复机器人自运动，在无位姿标签和辅助传感器的情况下达到有竞争力的精度。

TLDR: RFWalk is a self-supervised RF-only odometry framework that learns dense correspondences via cycle consistency and a Doppler consistency loss, then recovers robot ego-motion through robust SE(2) registration, achieving competitive accuracy without pose labels or auxiliary sensors.

Abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) sensing enables robot ego-motion estimation in darkness, smoke, and fog, yet RF odometry remains challenging because multipath and moving reflectors make cross-frame matching highly ambiguous. Existing methods often rely on auxiliary inertial sensors or ground-truth pose supervision. We present RFWalk, a self-supervised, RF-only odometry framework that models dense correspondences across range-azimuth frames as random walks on a space-time graph and learns them from unlabeled sequences through temporal cycle consistency. To rule out correspondences that are cycle-consistent but physically implausible, we introduce a Doppler consistency loss that constrains correspondence-induced motion using radial velocity measured by the RF sensor itself. Ego-motion is then recovered through robust $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ registration that suppresses uncertain correspondences and those arising from independently moving objects. Without pose labels or auxiliary sensors, RFWalk remains competitive with supervised baselines in static scenes and reduces absolute trajectory error by 58% in dynamic scenes with moving pedestrians.

摘要（中文）：射频（RF）感知能够在黑暗、烟雾和雾霾环境中实现机器人自运动估计，然而由于多径效应和移动反射体导致跨帧匹配高度模糊，射频里程计仍面临挑战。现有方法通常依赖辅助惯性传感器或真实位姿监督。我们提出RFWalk，一种自监督的纯射频里程计框架，该框架将距离-方位帧之间的密集对应关系建模为时空图上的随机游走，并通过时间循环一致性从无标签序列中学习这些对应关系。为了排除那些满足循环一致性但在物理上不可信的对应关系，我们引入了一种多普勒一致性损失，利用射频传感器自身测量的径向速度来约束由对应关系诱导的运动。随后通过鲁棒的$\mathrm{SE}(2)$配准恢复自运动，该配准能够抑制不确定的对应关系以及由独立运动物体产生的对应关系。在没有位姿标签或辅助传感器的情况下，RFWalk在静态场景中与有监督基线方法保持竞争力，并在存在行人运动的动态场景中将绝对轨迹误差降低了58%。

Authors: Kunzhe Song, Jialuo Du, Jingkai Lin, Huacheng Zeng

Open-World Object Motion Anticipation via Meta-Learned Semantic Adaptation RLRobot

object motion anticipation meta-learning graph neural network robot navigation open-world

简要说明：本文提出了一种元学习图神经网络，通过利用语义、几何和关系历史来预测开放世界机器人导航中新物体的运动，并在仿真和硬件上展示了优于VLM和基线的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a meta-learned graph neural network that predicts the motion of novel objects in open-world robot navigation by leveraging semantic, geometric, and relational histories, and demonstrates superior performance over a VLM and baseline in simulation and on hardware.

Abstract: Anticipating the motion of nearby objects is critical for safe and efficient robot navigation. Without a proper understanding of what may move, a robot may plan overly conservative, inefficient trajectories to guarantee safety, or it may be overly risky, resulting in unacceptable collisions. While tracking and predicting the motion of known objects has seen significant progress, little research addresses how a robot should adapt online to novel objects, including anticipating how one object may move another (e.g., a person operating a forklift to move a pallet). To enable this capability, we propose a meta-learned graph neural network that leverages a semantic, geometric, and relational history of objects to accurately predict, from a few online observations, when objects will begin to move in new environments. We demonstrate that our method, which is trained only in simulation, accurately anticipates the motion of objects unseen at training time, transfers to hardware without any fine-tuning, and outperforms a vision-language model and a class-frequency baseline in both simulation and hardware experiments. Our method's accurate prediction enables collision-free traversals in a closed-loop navigation simulation, while remaining within four seconds of the fastest, collision-prone planner.

摘要（中文）：预测附近物体的运动对于安全高效的机器人导航至关重要。如果机器人不能正确理解哪些物体可能移动，它可能会规划过于保守、低效的轨迹以确保安全，或者可能过于冒险，导致不可接受的碰撞。尽管在跟踪和预测已知物体的运动方面已取得显著进展，但很少有研究关注机器人应如何在线适应新物体，包括预测一个物体可能如何移动另一个物体（例如，人操作叉车来移动托盘）。为了实现这一能力，我们提出了一种元学习图神经网络，利用物体的语义、几何和关系历史，从少量在线观测中准确预测物体在新环境中何时开始移动。我们证明，我们的方法仅在仿真中训练，却能准确预测训练时未见过的物体的运动，无需任何微调即可迁移到硬件，并在仿真和硬件实验中均优于视觉语言模型和类别频率基线。我们的方法通过准确预测，在闭环导航仿真中实现了无碰撞通行，同时与最快的、易发生碰撞的规划器相比，时间差距保持在四秒以内。

Authors: Mason Peterson, Gage MacLin, Camilla Tabasso, Jonathan P. How, Joshua Migdal, Tye Brady, Taskin Padir

Learning Event-based Obstacle Avoidance via Differentiable Simulation RLRobot

event cameras obstacle avoidance differentiable simulation quadrotor end-to-end policy

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于CUDA的事件模拟器，集成到可微分仿真流程中，训练将事件帧直接映射到控制命令的四旋翼避障端到端策略，并通过零样本真实世界部署验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a CUDA-based event simulator integrated into a differentiable simulation pipeline to train an end-to-end quadrotor obstacle avoidance policy mapping event frames directly to control commands, validated with zero-shot real-world deployment.

Abstract: Reliable obstacle avoidance is essential for safe quadrotor flight in unknown environments, yet conventional frame-based cameras remain challenged by motion blur, limited dynamic range, and latency under fast motion. Event cameras, with sub-millisecond latency, high dynamic range, and negligible motion blur, offer a promising alternative, but leveraging them for closed-loop control remains difficult. Existing approaches either adopt cascaded architectures that first estimate depth and then map it to control commands, introducing error propagation, or achieve end-to-end control through costly offline pretraining before online fine-tuning can even begin. We address these challenges with a CUDA-based event simulator that exploits GPU parallelism to render events efficiently within the training loop, integrated into a differentiable simulation pipeline that enables direct gradient backpropagation through the differentiable physics model, improving sample efficiency. This allows us to train an end-to-end policy that maps event frames directly to control commands, without intermediate depth estimation. We validate our approach through zero-shot real-world deployment on a quadrotor, achieving robust obstacle avoidance in both odometry-assisted and odometry-free settings, including under low-light conditions where conventional cameras typically fail.

摘要（中文）：可靠的避障能力是四旋翼飞行器在未知环境中安全飞行的关键，然而传统基于帧的相机在快速运动下仍然受制于运动模糊、动态范围有限和延迟等问题。事件相机具有亚毫秒级延迟、高动态范围和可忽略的运动模糊等优势，提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但将其用于闭环控制仍然困难。现有方法要么采用级联架构，先估计深度再将其映射为控制指令，从而引入误差传播；要么通过昂贵的离线预训练实现端到端控制，之后才能开始在线微调。我们通过一种基于CUDA的事件模拟器来应对这些挑战，该模拟器利用GPU并行性在训练循环内高效渲染事件，并集成到可微分仿真流水线中，使梯度能够通过可微分物理模型直接反向传播，从而提升样本效率。这使我们能够训练一个端到端策略，将事件帧直接映射为控制指令，无需中间深度估计。我们通过在四旋翼上进行零样本真实世界部署验证了所提方法，在带里程计和无里程计设置下均实现了鲁棒的避障，包括在传统相机通常会失效的低光照条件下。

Authors: Chenlu Shou, Yunfan Ren, Jiaxu Xing, Davide Scaramuzza

Value Function-Guided MPPI for Hierarchical Planning and Control in Off-Road Autonomous Navigation AutonomousDriving

MPPI value function off-road navigation hierarchical planning reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种分层越野自主导航框架，将MPPI规划器与预训练的强化学习控制器集成，利用控制器的价值函数作为隐式成本图，并引入在线策略评估以适应分布偏移，在无显式成本图的情况下实现更安全有效的导航。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hierarchical off-road autonomous navigation framework that integrates an MPPI planner with a pretrained RL controller, using the controller's value function as an implicit cost map and introducing online policy evaluation to adapt to distribution shift, achieving safer and more effective navigation without explicit cost maps.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in off-road terrain is commonly achieved using hierarchical control and planning architectures that rely on explicit cost maps and one-way information flow from a high-level planner to a low-level controller, decoupling planning from the true execution cost experienced during control. We propose a hierarchical planning and control framework in which information flows bidirectionally, allowing the low-level controller to guide trajectory selection at the planning level. The highest level of the hierarchy is a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control-style planner that determines optimal trajectories and passes these waypoints to a pretrained low-level reinforcement learning (RL) controller. Rather than drawing from an explicit cost map, our MPPI planner leverages the value function of the RL controller as an implicit cost representation. In this formulation, MPPI serves as a trajectory exploration mechanism, while the low-level controller's value function guides the search. To account for the distribution shift seen by the value function between training and evaluation, we propose an online policy evaluation process that adapts the value function to unseen driving experiences, and we demonstrate this adaptation in unseen off-road simulation environments. We evaluate our approach in a high-fidelity off-road driving simulator across a range of challenging terrain conditions and compare its performance against a baseline MPPI controller. The results demonstrate that our method achieves safer and more effective navigation to goal locations while eliminating the need for explicit cost maps and enabling tighter coupling between planning and control.

摘要（中文）：越野地形中的自主导航通常采用分层控制与规划架构，该架构依赖显式代价地图以及从高层规划器到低层控制器单向信息流，从而将规划与控制过程中实际执行代价解耦。我们提出了一种分层规划与控制框架，其中信息双向流动，允许低层控制器在规划层面引导轨迹选择。该层次结构的最高层是一个模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制风格的规划器，用于确定最优轨迹并将这些路点传递给预训练的低层强化学习（RL）控制器。我们的MPPI规划器并非从显式代价地图中获取信息，而是利用RL控制器的价值函数作为隐式代价表示。在这一形式化中，MPPI充当轨迹探索机制，而低层控制器的价值函数则引导搜索。为了应对价值函数在训练与评估之间所见的分布偏移，我们提出了一种在线策略评估过程，使价值函数能够适应未见的驾驶经验，并在未见的越野仿真环境中展示了这种适应性。我们在高保真越野驾驶仿真器中，在一系列具有挑战性的地形条件下评估了我们的方法，并将其性能与基线MPPI控制器进行了比较。结果表明，我们的方法在无需显式代价地图的同时，实现了更安全、更有效地导航至目标位置，并促成了规划与控制之间更紧密的耦合。

Authors: Anoushka Alavilli, Raymond Song, Guanya Shi, Jeff Schneider

Explore Where It Matters: Targeted Exploration for Efficient Rover Adaptation WorldModel

targeted exploration online adaptation world model sim-to-real planetary rover

简要说明：TERRA是一种在线自适应框架，通过奖励加权预测损失和学习到的损失预测器来引导定向探索，使仿真训练的世界模型适应真实行星漫游车在可变形地形上的任务。在仿真中五次试验内达到约90%爬坡成功率，并在ERNEST漫游车上三到五次真实试验内恢复主动悬架运动。

TLDR: TERRA is an online adaptation framework that uses reward-weighted prediction loss and a learned loss predictor to guide targeted exploration for adapting a simulation-trained world model to real planetary rovers on deformable terrain. It achieves ~90% slope-climbing success in simulation within five trials and recovers active-suspension locomotion on the ERNEST rover within three to five real-world trials.

Abstract: Future planetary rovers will traverse steep, deformable terrain where slip, sinkage, and terrain deformation can threaten mobility. Although simulation can capture some wheel-soil effects, unmodeled deformable-terrain phenomena create sim-to-real gaps requiring deployment-time adaptation. Yet, rover operations leave little room for extensive trial-and-error. We introduce TERRA (Targeted Exploration for Reward-Relevant Adaptation), an online adaptation framework that efficiently seeks deployment data exposing task-relevant model errors and corrects them. TERRA adapts a simulation-trained world model with a reward-weighted prediction loss and trains a loss predictor to estimate where future performance-relevant errors are likely to occur, using this signal to guide exploration during MPC. In simulation, TERRA reaches approximately 90% slope-climbing success within five trials under severe out-of-distribution pretraining conditions, outperforming exploration baselines in reward, completion time, and energy to first success. On the ERNEST rover, TERRA recovers coordinated active-suspension locomotion on a deformable Mars-simulant slope within three to five real-world trials. Project website: https://terra-explore.github.io

摘要（中文）：未来的行星巡视器将在陡峭、可变形的地形上行驶，在这些地形中，打滑、下陷以及地形变形可能对机动性构成威胁。尽管仿真能够捕捉部分轮土相互作用效应，但未建模的可变形地形现象仍会造成仿真与真实环境之间的差距，需要在部署阶段进行适应性调整。然而，巡视器操作几乎没有留出大量试错的空间。我们提出了TERRA（面向奖励相关适应的定向探索），这是一种在线适应框架，能够高效地寻找暴露任务相关模型误差的部署数据并对其加以修正。TERRA采用奖励加权预测损失来适应仿真训练的世界模型，并训练一个损失预测器来估计未来可能出现性能相关误差的位置，并利用该信号在MPC过程中引导探索。在仿真中，即使面对严重的分布外预训练条件，TERRA也能在五次试验内达到约90%的爬坡成功率，在奖励、完成时间以及首次成功所需能量方面均优于其他探索基线。在ERNEST巡视器上，TERRA在可变形火星模拟斜坡上仅通过三到五次真实世界试验便恢复了协调的主动悬架运动能力。项目网站：https://terra-explore.github.io

Authors: Jacob Levy, Arthur Bouton, Tristan D. Hassler, Hari Nayar, David Fridovich-Keil

LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models Perception3D

adversarial robustness LiDAR-based 3D perception Dockerized framework semantic segmentation object detection

简要说明：LiDAR-SHIELD 是一个容器化的统一框架，用于评估基于 LiDAR 的 3D 感知模型的对抗鲁棒性，通过 HTTP 端点暴露模型，支持语义分割和目标检测攻击，旨在简化自动驾驶和机器人应用中的压力测试。

TLDR: LiDAR-SHIELD is a Dockerized, unified framework for adversarial robustness assessment of LiDAR-based 3D perception models, exposing models via HTTP endpoints to support semantic segmentation and object detection attacks. It aims to simplify stress-testing for autonomous driving and robotics applications.

Abstract: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield.

摘要（中文）：基于LiDAR的3D感知是自动驾驶和机器人技术的基石，然而，在真实世界部署这些模型之前，必须通过对抗性输入对其进行压力测试以确保安全。尽管已有最先进的对抗性攻击方法，但它们的实现往往分散在各个独立的代码库中，每个都绑定特定的架构或任务，需要手动重建环境并编写特定模型的集成代码。我们提出LIDARSHIELD，一个统一且完全Docker化的框架，它颠覆了这一流程：LIDARSHIELD并非在工具包内部安装目标模型，而是通过三个轻量级HTTP端点（即/info、/forward和/gradient）暴露任意模型。因此，接入新模型或数据集仅需一个加载函数或适配器。该框架通过同一引擎-服务协议支持3D语义分割和3D目标检测，集成了任务感知的最先进攻击套件，包括针对分割任务的PGD和Square Attack，以及针对检测任务的点扰动、点删除、点注入和LiDAttack。这使得能够系统地揭示异构LiDAR主干网络中的边界案例和漏洞。LiDAR-Shield代码库公开于https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield。

Authors: Alexandros Gkillas, Ioulia Kapsali, Christos Anagnostopoulos, Aris S. Lalos

Context Compaction for World Models WorldModel

context compaction world model context retrieval dreaming agent harness

简要说明：本文为世界模型提出了上下文压缩的基准测试和智能体框架，证明上下文压缩使世界模型无需重新训练即可在上下文窗口之外检索房间至多4倍，而滑动窗口注意力在梦境生成时会丢失大部分上下文检索能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark and an agent harness for context compaction in world models, demonstrating that context compaction allows world models to retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining, while sliding-window attention suffers during dreaming.

Abstract: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. Second, we build an agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, which to our knowledge no prior work has studied. Third, we use our benchmark to study four world model designs. Context compaction lets our world models retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining. However, world models with sliding-window attention lose most of their context retrieval when dreaming. Therefore, a dreaming world agent benefits more from extending the reach of its world model using context compaction than switching to sliding window attention at the model layer.

摘要（中文）：世界模型让观察者能够探索生成的世界并与之互动。近期研究表明，当观察者故地重游时，现有模型往往难以保持场景生成的一致性。我们将此视为一个上下文检索问题。大语言模型智能体在其架构的两个层面管理上下文检索。在模型层面，KV缓存设计决定了内存中可容纳的上下文量。在智能体框架层面，诸如Claude Code等框架负责选择发送给大语言模型的上下文。以往关于世界模型的研究大多仅关注模型层面。本文做出三点贡献。首先，我们构建了一个基准来评估世界模型的上下文检索能力。该基准为每个回合生成全新世界，防止模型通过训练数据回忆房间场景，同时将上下文检索与基于邻近帧的猜测区分开来。其次，我们构建了一个智能体框架，实现了针对世界模型的上下文压缩功能，据我们所知，此前尚无相关研究。第三，我们利用该基准研究了四种世界模型设计。上下文压缩使我们的世界模型能够在无需重新训练的情况下，检索超出其上下文窗口4倍范围的场景。然而，采用滑动窗口注意力的世界模型在梦境生成时几乎丧失了大部分上下文检索能力。因此，相较于在模型层面切换至滑动窗口注意力，梦境世界智能体通过上下文压缩来扩展其世界模型的覆盖范围能获得更大收益。

Authors: Hayder Tirmazi

WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration WorldModel

video world models long-horizon exploration goal-conditioned agent benchmark spatial consistency

简要说明：WorldProbe提出了一个诊断基准，用于评估视频世界模型在长期目标导向相机探索中的表现，揭示了最先进模型能保持局部视觉质量但在长期一致性上存在不足，突显了现有评估的空白。

TLDR: WorldProbe introduces a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating video world models under long-horizon, goal-conditioned camera exploration, revealing that state-of-the-art models maintain local visual quality but suffer from long-range inconsistencies and weak memory, highlighting a critical evaluation gap.

Abstract: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型根据相机或动作输入生成未来的视觉观测，其目标在于合成可随时间和空间进行探索的持久三维世界。现有基准测试通常评估短时间交互，或依赖于在生成前固定好的相机轨迹。视频世界模型在长时间探索及大幅度相机运动条件下的表现仍未得到充分研究。为此，我们引入了WorldProbe，一种诊断性基准测试，利用基于目标条件的多模态智能体在生成过程中在线调整相机动作。WorldProbe包含四个探测家族下的164个测试案例。针对10种最先进的模型，我们生成了超过1,600条轨迹，总时长约800分钟，最长水平达180秒。我们的评估涵盖四个维度，既揭示了局部度量指标的下滑，也展示了远距离不一致性的出现。研究发现，近期模型在视觉及内容质量上能维持更长时间，但其长期记忆与演化能力依然薄弱。这些结果表明，局部稳定生成与持续世界一致性之间仍存在差距，而这一点在现有基准测试中大多被忽视。相关代码及基准资源可在https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe获取。

Authors: Minqi Wang, Jie Peng, Hejun Dong, Ruchang Yao, Puyi Wang, Siyuan Huang, Jihai Zhang, Yafu Li, Qi Dou, Xiaoye Qu, Yu Cheng

Structural-Test Geometry as an Inductive Bias for Partially Observable World Models WorldModel

world models partially observable inductive bias quotient-preserving planning

简要说明：本文研究如何在部分可观测世界模型的潜在几何上施加来自特权模拟器访问的结构信息，提出通过将潜在距离对齐到后验边缘化结构测试伪度量来训练商保持（QP）世界模型。在六任务诊断套件中，QP在规划成功率和几何对齐上优于度量解码和结构化信念蒸馏。

TLDR: This paper investigates how to impose structural information from privileged simulator access onto latent geometries of partially observable world models, proposing quotient-preserving (QP) world models that align latent distances to a posterior-marginalized structural-test pseudometric. QP improves planning success and geometric alignment over metric decoding and structured belief distillation on a six-task diagnostic suite.

Abstract: Predictive world-model objectives need not organize latent histories according to distinctions required for later control. With privileged simulator access during training, should response-derived structural information be predicted, decoded, or imposed directly on latent geometry--and how do these choices compare with structured belief distillation? We define posterior-marginalized structural tests whose response distributions induce a pseudometric over histories, then train quotient-preserving (QP) world models by aligning shared latent Euclidean distances to that metric. Across a fixed six-task diagnostic suite, the largest differences appear under held-out structural variation: QP improves planning success by 26.1 points $[21.5,30.7]$ over metric decoding and 6.4 points $[3.8,9.0]$ over structured belief distillation. On GridWorld, metric decoding accurately recovers held-out structural distances ($ρ=.91$) while its native latent geometry remains more distorted than QP's (paired IQD difference $.22$ $[.20,.24]$), showing that relational recoverability and direct geometric alignment can diverge.

摘要（中文）：预测性世界模型的目标并不需要根据后续控制所需的各种区分来组织潜在历史。在训练期间拥有特权模拟器访问权限时，响应衍生的结构信息应当被预测、解码，还是直接施加于潜在几何结构之上——这些选择与结构化信念蒸馏相比又如何？我们定义了后验边缘化的结构测试，其响应分布诱导出历史之上的伪度量，然后通过将共享潜在欧氏距离与该度量对齐，训练保持商结构（QP）的世界模型。在固定的六任务诊断套件中，最大的差异出现在保留的结构变化下：QP在规划成功率上比度量解码提高了26.1个百分点$[21.5,30.7]$，比结构化信念蒸馏提高了6.4个百分点$[3.8,9.0]$。在GridWorld中，度量解码能够准确恢复保留的结构距离（$ρ=.91$），而其原生潜在几何结构的畸变程度仍高于QP（配对IQD差异$.22$ $[.20,.24]$），这表明关系可恢复性与直接几何对齐可能会产生分歧。

Authors: Todd Y. Zhou

Geometric Time Score Estimators: Bridging Self-Predictive Representations and Generative Occupancy Models For Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

reinforcement learning occupancy density estimation self-predictive representations generative occupancy models geometric time score estimators

简要说明：该论文提出了几何时间分数估计器（GTSE），该框架弥合了自预测表示与生成占用模型之间的差距，以改进占用密度估计，并提升运动与操作任务中的强化学习性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces Geometric Time Score Estimators (GTSE), a framework that bridges self-predictive representations and generative occupancy models to improve occupancy density estimation and reinforcement learning performance on locomotion and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: In reinforcement learning (RL), temporal reasoning is essential for estimating the density of future outcomes under a policy's occupancy measure. While self-predictive representations have been a dominant paradigm for occupancy density estimation, we find that they yield surprisingly poor estimates. On the other hand, generative occupancy models can produce remarkably accurate samples from the occupancy measure. Yet, they cannot easily recover occupancy densities, limiting their use for control despite their expressivity. In this paper, we propose Geometric Time Score Estimators (GTSE), a framework that bridges the two paradigms by learning occupancy density estimators along probability paths. We analyze how GTSE implicitly induces better occupancy estimators through improved representation learning and show how to directly extract self-predictive representations from this framework. Through experiments across several locomotion and manipulation tasks, we show that GTSE improves performance over state-of-the-art methods by $2\times$ to $6\times$ in goal-conditioned RL settings, and that the representations learned using our framework transfer effectively to downstream RL tasks. Website: https://aravindvenu7.github.io/website/gtse/

摘要（中文）：在强化学习（RL）中，时间推理对于在策略占用度量下估计未来结果的密度至关重要。尽管自预测表征一直是占用密度估计的主导范式，但我们发现它们产生的估计出奇地差。另一方面，生成式占用模型可以从占用度量中生成非常准确的样本。然而，它们难以恢复占用密度，这限制了它们在控制中的应用，尽管其具有强大的表达能力。在本文中，我们提出了几何时间分数估计器（GTSE），这是一个通过学习沿概率路径的占用密度估计器来弥合两种范式的框架。我们分析了GTSE如何通过改进表征学习隐式地诱导更好的占用估计器，并展示了如何从该框架中直接提取自预测表征。通过在多个运动和控制任务上的实验，我们表明GTSE在目标条件RL设置中将性能相比最先进方法提升了$2\times$到$6\times$，并且使用我们框架学习到的表征能够有效地迁移到下游RL任务。网站：https://aravindvenu7.github.io/website/gtse/

Authors: Aravind Venugopal, Grace Liu, Jeff Schneider, Benjamin Eysenbach

SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors Other

action anticipation neuro-symbolic knowledge graph scene graph long-horizon

简要说明：SymAnt提出了一种神经符号方法，通过联合搜索场景图和知识图构建符号上下文，为迭代细化过程提供基础，从而从短视频观察中预测长时程未来动作。该方法参数高效、可解释，并允许用户无需重新训练即可编辑符号先验以调整预测。

TLDR: SymAnt introduces a neuro-symbolic approach for long-horizon action anticipation from short video observations, jointly searching scene and knowledge graphs to construct a symbolic context that grounds an iterative refinement process for future action prediction. The method is parameter-efficient, interpretable, and allows users to edit symbolic priors without retraining.

Abstract: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人和智能系统与人类的互动日益频繁，它们必须仅凭少量观察就能预测未来的长序列动作。然而，纯神经网络模型通常需要大量观察数据来预测未来动作，且难以解释和调整，而符号先验则提供了一种结构化的替代方案。为此，我们提出了SymAnt，一种新颖的神经符号方法，它将神经网络的表达能力与场景图和知识图谱的结构化推理统一起来。给定一段短视频，SymAnt对两种图谱进行联合搜索以构建符号上下文，从而实现对空间关系、物体属性、可供性及相关动作的统一推理。该符号上下文作为迭代精化过程的先验，逐步生成并改进未来动作序列。通过将预测建立在符号上下文之上，SymAnt以参数高效的方式从短观察窗口预测长时程动作，同时允许用户直接编辑底层知识以调整预测，无需进一步训练。通过实验，我们在五个多样化数据集——Breakfast、50 Salads、EPIC-KITCHENS、EGTEA Gaze+和Assembly101——上验证了SymAnt的有效性，尤其是在仅有短观察上下文的情况下。

Authors: Fnu Aryan, Yaqi Xie, Joseph Campbell, Woojun Kim, Kwonjoon Lee, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi-Pari, Katia Sycara, Simon Stepputtis

Optimal Path Planning with Localization constraints Other

UAV path planning localization constraint A* search Extended Kalman Filter GPS-denied

简要说明：本文提出了一种在无GPS环境中考虑定位约束的A*无人机路径规划方法，将估计不确定性作为硬约束，并通过EKF传播协方差，在仿真和PyBullet四旋翼实验中相比RRT*和PRM实现了更短且更可靠的路径。

TLDR: This paper introduces a localization-constrained A* planner for UAV path planning in GPS-denied environments, treating estimation uncertainty as a hard constraint and using an EKF for covariance propagation, demonstrating shorter and more reliable paths than RRT* and PRM in simulations and PyBullet quadrotor tests.

Abstract: This paper studies UAV path planning in areas where GPS signals are not present. Because these drones can easily get lost when they don't have GPS, they must rely on dead reckoning and occasionally pass near cellular towers, which act as landmarks to reset and fix their position. The goal is to find the shortest path from a start to a goal location while keeping the estimation uncertainty within a given bound. To solve this problem, we propose a localization-constrained A* planner that treats uncertainty as a hard constraint during search. The robot state and covariance are propagated using an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF), and only paths that satisfy the covariance limit are considered. We also show that the proposed method does not affect heuristic used in A* and remains admissible and consistent, ensuring optimality among all feasible paths. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and PyBullet quadrotor test show that the proposed method finds shorter and more reliable paths compared to RRT* and PRM, while always satisfying the uncertainty constraint.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了在无GPS信号区域中的无人机路径规划问题。由于这些无人机在没有GPS的情况下很容易迷失方向，因此它们必须依赖航位推算，并偶尔靠近蜂窝基站，将基站作为地标来重置和修正自身位置。目标是在将估计不确定性保持在给定范围内的同时，找到从起点到目标位置的最短路径。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种定位约束A*规划器，在搜索过程中将不确定性视为硬约束。机器人状态和协方差通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）进行传播，并且仅考虑满足协方差限制的路径。我们还证明了所提方法不会影响A*中使用的启发式函数，并且保持可采纳性和一致性，从而确保在所有可行路径中的最优性。大量蒙特卡洛仿真和PyBullet四旋翼测试表明，与RRT*和PRM相比，所提方法能够找到更短且更可靠的路径，同时始终满足不确定性约束。

Authors: Chinmay Mundane, Manav Mishra, PB Sujit

MUSBRIC: LEGO-Compatible Pneumatic Muscle Bricks for Reconfigurable Musculoskeletal Robots Locomotion

pneumatic artificial muscles reconfigurable robots musculoskeletal robots LEGO-compatible modules MuJoCo simulation

简要说明：MUSBRIC 提出与乐高兼容的气动肌肉积木及配套 MuJoCo 仿真器，用于快速重构肌肉骨骼机器人，并展示了肘关节、机械手与四足机器人。

TLDR: MUSBRIC introduces LEGO-compatible pneumatic muscle bricks and a MuJoCo simulator for rapidly reconfigurable musculoskeletal robots, demonstrated on an elbow joint, robotic hand, and quadruped.

Abstract: Musculoskeletal robots combine compliant actuators with articulated skeletons, but exploring alternative configurations often requires repeated fabrication. We present MUSBRIC, a modular hardware platform and accompanying MuJoCo-based simulator for reconfigurable musculoskeletal robots. LEGO-compatible endcaps turn fiber-reinforced extensile pneumatic artificial muscles into reusable, plug-and-play muscle bricks that connect directly to standard LEGO components. Experimentally identified actuator behavior supports corresponding musculoskeletal simulations. An elbow-joint prototype validates load-dependent flexion and extension, showing that pulley-guided routing enables reversible motion and a mechanical stop stabilizes the straight posture. A robotic hand demonstrates compliant grasping and multi-joint construction. Matched hardware and simulation sweeps across 15 leg configurations demonstrate systematic exploration of attachment geometry, while a quadruped assembled from four legs demonstrates walking. Together, these demonstrations span mechanism analysis, configuration exploration, and functional robot construction within a single reconfigurable system. The hardware designs and simulation code will be released as open source soon to facilitate reproduction and further development.

摘要（中文）：肌肉骨骼机器人将柔性执行器与关节骨架相结合，但探索替代构型往往需要反复制造。我们提出了MUSBRIC，一个模块化硬件平台及配套的基于MuJoCo的仿真器，用于可重构肌肉骨骼机器人。与LEGO兼容的端盖将纤维增强伸展型气动人工肌肉转变为可重复使用、即插即用的肌肉砖块，可直接连接到标准LEGO组件。实验表征的执行器行为支持相应的肌肉骨骼仿真。一个肘关节原型验证了载荷相关的屈伸运动，表明滑轮引导走线可实现可逆运动，机械限位可稳定伸直姿态。一只机器人手展示了柔性抓取和多关节构建。在15种腿部构型上进行的硬件与仿真匹配扫描展示了连接几何的系统化探索，而由四条腿组装而成的四足机器人展示了行走功能。这些演示共同涵盖了单一可重构系统内的机构分析、构型探索和功能机器人构建。硬件设计和仿真代码将很快作为开源发布，以促进复现和进一步开发。

Authors: Qiyao Wang, Yinglei Zhu, Liang Zhou, Wenzhe Gong, Xin-Jun Liu, Huichan Zhao

CuBot-STT: Simultaneously Transport and Tighten for Lattice-type Modular Reconfiguration Robot RLRobot

modular reconfigurable robot transport and tightening helical locking goal-conditioned Q-learning autonomous reconfiguration

简要说明：CuBot-STT 是一种外置机器人，可同时完成晶格型模块化可重构机器人的模块运输与锁紧，并结合学习规划器实现自主重构。

TLDR: CuBot-STT is an external robot that simultaneously transports and tightens lattice-type modular reconfigurable robot modules, integrating locking and release with a learned planner for autonomous reconfiguration.

Abstract: Lattice-type modular reconfigurable robots rearrange standardized modules across tasks. Dedicated transport robots reduce module weight and cost by eliminating module level reconfiguration actuators. But existing systems use low capacity connections or internal fastening robots that occupy space for functional components. This paper presents CuBot-STT, which integrates module transport, interface locking, and release in one external robot. Cubic modules provide structural support and $24\,\mathrm{V}$ power distribution. On each face, a gear transmission converts one external input into motion of four helical locking points, preserving internal space. The robot uses alternating foot support, a gripper for module handling, and a tightening head for interface actuation. The controller coordinates two-foot support and module locking through continuous constraint transfers. The planner decomposes relocation costs into an analytical lower bound and a residual learned through expert-guided, goal conditioned Q-learning. Contact face $A^*$ search expands relocation sequences into robot primitives satisfying connectivity, asymmetric manipulation, and foot stance constraints. Experiments demonstrate normal and tangential interface capacities of $300\,\mathrm{N}$ and $490\,\mathrm{N}$, electrical continuity across six modules, and autonomous reconfiguration of an 11-module lattice. Planning benchmarks show superior search efficiency over analytical guidance and bidirectional heuristic search, with generalization beyond training lattice sizes without fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 晶格型模块化可重构机器人通过在不同任务中重新布置标准化模块来适应需求。专用运输机器人通过取消模块级重构执行器来降低模块重量和成本。但现有系统采用低承载能力连接，或使用会占用功能部件空间的内部紧固机器人。本文提出CuBot-STT，将模块运输、接口锁定与释放集成于一个外部机器人中。立方体模块提供结构支撑和$24\,\mathrm{V}$配电。在每个面上，齿轮传动将单一路外部输入转换为四个螺旋锁点的运动，从而保留内部空间。该机器人采用交替足部支撑、用于模块操作的夹爪以及用于接口驱动的拧紧头。控制器通过连续约束转移来协调双脚支撑与模块锁定。规划器将重定位成本分解为解析下界和通过专家引导、目标条件Q学习获得的残差。接触面$A^*$搜索将重定位序列扩展为满足连通性、非对称操作和足部站姿约束的机器人原语。实验表明，接口法向和切向承载能力分别为$300\,\mathrm{N}$和$490\,\mathrm{N}$，六个模块间实现电气连续性，并可自主重构一个11模块晶格。规划基准测试表明，其搜索效率优于解析引导和双向启发式搜索，并且无需微调即可泛化到训练晶格尺寸之外。

Authors: Chongxi Meng, Da Zhao, Yanmin Zhou, Runjie Shen, Zhipeng Wang, Bin He

EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents Other

experience transfer subgoal composition embodied agents outcome-grounded failure utilization

简要说明：EmbodiExp 提出了一种框架，用于在具身任务执行过程中在线转移和组合基于结果的目标子经验，从而实现跨任务的有效经验迁移和失败利用。

TLDR: EmbodiExp introduces a framework for transferring and composing outcome-grounded subgoal experiences online during embodied task execution, enabling effective experience transfer and failure utilization across tasks.

Abstract: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.

摘要（中文）：经验能够帮助具身智能体将高层规划转化为实际行动，但如何在不同任务间迁移经验仍具挑战性：先前有效的策略可能不适用于当前状态，或无法产生预期结果。我们提出EmbodiExp框架，用于构建可迁移经验并在具身任务执行过程中在线组合这些经验。我们的关键观察是，任务往往共享子目标，而这些子目标的完成情况可以独立于整体任务成功与否进行评估。为此，我们引入一种基于结果锚定的子目标经验，该经验包含子目标定义、适用条件、可调整策略以及可验证的结果。在执行过程中，适用的经验指导动作生成，而验证通过的结果可建立后续经验所需的条件，从而实现在线组合。子目标层面的结果归因还进一步支持失败利用：失败的轨迹仍可贡献已验证的局部成功，并提供针对应避免动作的情境化指导。我们在多种具身基准上采用折叠协议并冻结经验库进行实验，结果验证了EmbodiExp的有效性。

Authors: Zhifeng Gu, Ying Chen, Rui Jiang, Lei Yi, Bing Wang

Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement WorldModel

agentic video generation agentic world modeling recursive self-improvement video world models agent harness

简要说明：本报告探讨了视频生成与智能体框架的交叉领域，涵盖代理式视频生成、代理式世界建模以及视频模型与智能体系统的递归自我改进。

TLDR: This report explores the intersection of video generation and agent harnesses, covering agentic video generation, agentic world modeling, and recursive self-improvement for video models and agentic systems.

Abstract: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.

摘要（中文）：视频生成正从端到端合成转向智能体驱动生成，其中规划、工具使用和反馈机制使得连贯、可控的多镜头视频成为可能。与此同时，视频世界模型提供基于动作条件的观测和未来预测，充当智能体的交互环境。我们通过智能体框架（Agent Harness）来研究二者的交汇点：一个可执行运行时，围绕视频模型构建上下文、暴露工具、维护状态、路由反馈并管理预算。本报告探讨三个方向。其一是智能体视频生成，框架协调脚本编写、镜头规划、资产管理、制作与剪辑，同时探讨这些系统的评估挑战。其二是智能体世界建模，框架在观测、控制、执行和状态之间进行中介。我们讨论混合设计，即游戏引擎或智能体编写的程序维护世界状态，而视频模型渲染观测结果，并探讨智能体与世界模型如何相互评估和改进。其三是视频模型开发中的递归自我改进（RSI），区分输出修订、框架状态更新、生成器参数与评估器的变更，以及改进流程本身的调整。我们分析这些改进如何反馈到后续开发中。围绕上述方向，我们剖析智能体的关键能力，包括视听感知、长视野规划、记忆、基于代码的交互、反馈引导控制、技能复用以及多智能体协同。最后，我们总结在自主视频制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模型开发、溯源、成本核算以及将视频质量与任务表现关联至模型和框架持续改进的评估等方面所面临的挑战。

Authors: Liaoyuan Fan, Yuhao Zheng, Dongxing Mao, Hangyu Ran, Siyuan Hu, Weijia Mao, Rui Zhao, Weijia Wu, Guian Fang, Yanzhe Chen, Zeyu Zhu, Yuxin Jiang, Yiren Song, Yuchao Gu, Junchao Yi, Qi Hu, Dan Kong, Alex Jinpeng Wang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou, Wei Liu

GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models WorldModel

video world models factorized memory long-horizon coherence static-dynamic factorization training-free memory injection

简要说明：GROME提出了一种面向视频世界模型的因子化记忆框架，将静态场景几何与动态实体状态解耦，无需训练即可实现长时程连贯性与可控视频续写。

TLDR: GROME introduces a factorized memory framework for video world models that decouples static scene geometry from dynamic entity states, enabling long-horizon coherence and controllable video continuation without training.

Abstract: Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.

摘要（中文）：长程一致性对于视频世界模型至关重要，然而一旦观测内容超出上下文窗口，这种一致性便难以维持。现有的记忆机制要么将历史信息作为隐式上下文进行检索，但这仍受限于上下文容量，并将静态信息与动态信息纠缠在一起；要么将历史信息整合为显式的全局表示，但这种方式难以建模演化的动态，且会累积几何误差。为克服上述局限，我们提出**GROME**，一种新颖的分解式记忆框架，用于增强视频世界模型在静态场景与动态实体上的长程一致性。GROME通过三个协同组件运作：1）\emph{静-动态分解}将历史证据解耦为静态与动态两个组成部分，分别保留静态场景几何与动态实体状态；2）\emph{局部记忆检索}选取空间对齐的静态历史以消除几何漂移，并结合最新的动态实体状态以保证时间连续性；3）\emph{免训练记忆注入}通过视频世界模型原生的条件通路，将分解后的记忆无缝嵌入其中。在长程重访场景上的实验表明，相较于现有方法，GROME显著提升了场景持久性与动态实体保真度，同时在不进行额外训练的情况下，保持了冻结骨干网络的视觉质量与可控性。除自回归生成外，GROME还可将外部观测轻松纳入作为即插即用记忆，从而支持灵活且可控的视频续写与场景探索。

Authors: Fang Yu, Xiaoxue Wu, Haiyu Zhang, Yangfu Li, Botong Zhao, Yu Qiao, Tianfan Xue, Yue Lu, Xinyuan Chen

FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration WorldModel

interactive video world model causal next-chunk predictor error recirculation long-horizon consistency action-conditioned

简要说明：本文针对交互式视频世界模型中的误差累积问题，提出了一种即插即用的因果下一块预测器（C-NCP），通过预测未来场景状态来指导生成，从而提高长时程一致性。

TLDR: This paper addresses error accumulation in interactive video world models by introducing a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) that predicts future scene states to guide generation, improving long-horizon consistency.

Abstract: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型旨在遵循用户动作的同时，在长时间交互中保持场景一致性。基于历史的方法通过重用生成的潜变量来保持场景内容，但这种重用存在三个局限，导致误差循环传播。1）每次交互生成的潜变量被保留为历史，其中可能包含模糊细节、几何畸变或语义漂移。2）尽管检索到的历史内容与当前场景匹配，但仍可能含有误差，并被带入下一片段。3）新的输出随后成为后续交互的历史，可能通过反复重用而加剧相同误差。为限制这一循环，我们旨在根据当前生成的潜变量和下一个动作，在生成下一交互视频片段之前预测未来场景状态。该未来状态先验为下一片段提供引导，以减少从历史中累积传递的误差。为此，我们提出了一种即插即用的因果下一片段预测器（C-NCP），具有跨模型适应性和预测引导调制能力。我们将C-NCP集成到四个基础生成器中，并在三个基准上评估增强模型，用于交互式长视频生成和动作条件世界建模。大量实验表明，该方法在多种生成设置下有效减少了误差累积，并提升了长程一致性。项目页面位于 https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld。

Authors: Guangyuan Li, Kelu Yao, Shuolin Xu, Xinlei Yu, Wei Xing, Lei Zhao, Peng-Tao Jiang, Xiaogang Xu, Xiaobin Hu

Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion Perception3D

LIDAR semantic segmentation domain generalization occupancy prediction point cloud scene completion

简要说明：本文提出了一种仅使用源域数据的训练方案，通过添加基于累积点云的占用预测辅助目标，提高激光雷达语义分割对未知传感器的泛化能力，且不增加推理开销。

TLDR: This paper introduces a source-only training scheme for LIDAR semantic segmentation that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective using accumulated point cloud data to improve domain generalization to unseen sensors without extra runtime cost.

Abstract: We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training. A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了激光雷达语义分割的域泛化问题。深度神经网络在三维点云上表现出强大的性能，然而现实世界中的激光雷达具有传感器特有的采样模式，这阻碍了跨数据集的迁移。在许多应用场景中，模型在完全未见过的传感器上的表现至关重要。理想的模型应能在不事先获取新设备数据或标签的情况下直接运行。为此，我们引入了一种仅使用源域数据的训练方案，该方案增加了一个占用预测辅助目标。我们将源域扫描聚合为一个简单的世界模型，并将其作为监督信号，替代了单次扫描的标准分割训练。 我们方法的一个关键特性是它不改变输入扫描数据。在训练和测试期间，网络处理的是相同的单帧激光雷达输入，仅仅是监督信号通过占用目标得到了丰富。在部署阶段，不存在运行时开销，因为辅助头可以被移除以进行纯分割，也可以保留以在语义分割的同时获得场景补全。在跨不同激光雷达数据集的实验评估中，我们证明了模型的跨域泛化能力会受到监督方式的显著影响。在某些设置下，在没有任何显式域适应（无目标扫描、无目标标签、无传感器先验）且不进行预测精炼的情况下，模型在未见域上的性能得到了提升。同时，我们的方法保持了具有竞争力的源域分割性能，且不产生额外的推理成本。
